children.text: sarvi kriya karitva anyamanyaṃ upagata paśyitu sarvalokanātham // SRS_10.74 //
children.translated_text: all, having informed one another, came to behold the Lord of All the World.' // SRS_10.74 //

children.text: tathapi ca kharakarṇa sūciromā āṭavikastatha yakṣa bheṣakaśca /
children.translated_text: 'And likewise <s>Kharakarṇa</s>, <s>Sūciromā</s>, <s>Āṭavika</s>, and the <s>Yakṣa</s> <s>Bheṣaka</s>,

children.text: haimavata śatagiriśca yakṣa upagata gardabhako jinaṃ svayaṃbhūm // SRS_10.75 //
children.translated_text: <s>Haimavata</s>, <s>Śatagiri</s>, and the <s>Yakṣa</s> <s>Gardabhaka</s> — approached the <s>Jina</s>, the Self-Arisen.' // SRS_10.75 //

children.text: indraketu vikaṭaśca surūpo vakkulu pañciku śākya pravṛddho /
children.translated_text: '<s>Indraketu</s>, <s>Vikaṭa</s>, <s>Surūpa</s>, <s>Vakkula</s>, <s>Pañcika</s>, <s>Śākya Pravṛddha</s> —

children.text: ete pare 'pi ca yakṣendra sahastā upagata dhūpaghaṭaṃ parigṛhya // SRS_10.76 //
children.translated_text: these and other <s>Yakṣa</s>-lords approached with their followers, bearing incense-pots.' // SRS_10.76 //

children.text: vikṛta bahu duḥsaṃsthitātmabhāvā vigalitaābharaṇā anekarūpāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Of deformed, unsightly bodies, with ornaments hanging loose, of manifold forms,

children.text: bahava śatasahasra tasmi kāle upagata tatra gṛhītva yakṣa puṣpān // SRS_10.77 //
children.translated_text: many hundreds of thousands at that time came there, <s>Yakṣas</s> bearing flowers.' // SRS_10.77 //

children.text: (Vaidya 66)
children.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 66)

children.text: jalanidhi nivasanti ye suparṇā upagata brāhmaṇaveśa nirmiṇitvā /
children.translated_text: 'The <s>Suparṇas</s> (Garuḍas) who dwell in the ocean came, having created <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-disguises,

children.text: mukuṭadhara vicitra darśanīyā gaganasthitāḥ sugataṃ namasyamānāḥ // SRS_10.78 //
children.translated_text: wearing crowns, of variegated and beautiful appearance — standing in the sky, bowing to the <s>Sugata</s>.' // SRS_10.78 //

children.text: nagaraśata ye keci jambudvīpe vanavihareṣu ya tatra devatāśca /
children.translated_text: 'Whatever deities of hundreds of cities in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, and the deities in forest-monasteries —

children.text: sarva nagaradevatāḥ samagrā upagata pūja karonta nāyakasya // SRS_10.79 //
children.translated_text: all the city-deities together approached, performing worship of the Leader.' // SRS_10.79 //

children.text: upagata vanadevatā anantāstathapi ca sarvi ya śailadevatāśca /
children.translated_text: 'Infinite forest-deities approached, and likewise all mountain-deities,

children.text: tathapi ca nadidevatāḥ samagrā upagata pūja karonta nāyakasya // SRS_10.80 //
children.translated_text: and likewise all river-deities together approached, performing worship of the Leader.' // SRS_10.80 //

children.text: aṭavimaruṣu devatāśatāni giriśikhareṣu ya devatā samagrāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Hundreds of deities in forests and wastelands, and deities gathered on mountain-peaks,

children.text: utsasarataḍāgadevatāśca upagata sāgaradevatāśca buddham // SRS_10.81 //
children.translated_text: and deities of springs, ponds, and lakes — and ocean-deities approached the <s>Buddha</s>.' // SRS_10.81 //

children.text: devaasuranāgayakṣasaṃghā garuḍamahoragakinnarāḥ kumbhāṇḍāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Hosts of gods, <s>Asuras</s>, <s>Nāgas</s>, <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Garuḍas</s>, <s>Mahoragas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>, <s>Kumbhāṇḍas</s>,

children.text: tathapi ca bahu pretapūtanāśco puruṣavarasya karonti citrikāram // SRS_10.82 //
children.translated_text: and also many <s>Pretas</s> and <s>Pūtanās</s> — they performed manifold worship of the best of men.' // SRS_10.82 //

body.text:
te 'pi ca jinavare karitva pūjāṃ nagaravaraṃ praviśanti nāyakasmin /
deva asuranāgayakṣarājā | satatamatṛpta bhavanti darśanena // SRS_10.83 //
body.translated_text: 'Having performed worship of the best of <s>Jinas</s>, they enter the excellent city as the Leader [enters]; gods, <s>Asuras</s>, <s>Nāga</s>-kings, and <s>Yakṣa</s>-kings — always insatiable in beholding [him].' // SRS_10.83 //

children.text: yatha purimabhaveṣu lokanāthaḥ purimajineṣu akārṣi pūja śreṣṭhām /
children.translated_text: 'As the Lord of the World in former lives performed supreme worship of former <s>Jinas</s> —

children.text: puṇyaphalavipāka evarūpo na ca janu tṛptu narendra paśyamānaḥ // SRS_10.84 //
children.translated_text: such is the fruition of merit; and the lord of men is never satiated by beholding [it].' // SRS_10.84 //

children.text: meru tatha sumeru cakravālā himagiristatha gandhamādanaśca /
children.translated_text: '<s>Meru</s>, <s>Sumeru</s>, the <s>Cakravāla</s> [mountains], <s>Himagiri</s> (Himālaya) and <s>Gandhamādana</s> —

children.text: (Vaidya 67)
children.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 67)

children.text: āvaraṇā na te jinasya bhonti ābha yadā jinu muñci buddhakṣetre // SRS_10.85 //
children.translated_text: these are no obstruction for the <s>Jina</s>, when the <s>Jina</s> releases radiance in the <s>Buddha</s>-field.' // SRS_10.85 //

children.text: ye ca iha samudra buddhakṣetre te 'pi mahīya samāstadā bhavanti /
children.translated_text: 'The oceans in this <s>Buddha</s>-field become level with the earth;

children.text: sarvamimu samantu buddhakṣetraṃ samu bhavatī kusumehi saṃprakīrṇam // SRS_10.86 //
children.translated_text: this entire <s>Buddha</s>-field all around becomes level, strewn with flowers.' // SRS_10.86 //

children.text: raśmi śatasahasra aprameyā avakiri pādatalehi dharmarājā /
children.translated_text: 'Immeasurable hundreds of thousands of rays are scattered from the soles of the <s>Dharma</s>-king's feet;

children.text: sarvi niraya śītalā bhavanti dharmaduḥkha upanīta sukhaṃ ca vedayanti // SRS_10.87 //
children.translated_text: all the hells become cool, and those beings, freed from suffering, experience happiness.' // SRS_10.87 //

children.text: dharma daśabala saṃprabhāṣi tatro marumanujāna viśuddha bhoti cakṣuḥ /
children.translated_text: 'There the Possessor of the Ten Powers teaches <s>Dharma</s> — the eye of gods and humans becomes purified;

children.text: prāṇi śatasahasra aprameyā niyata bhavanti ca sarvi buddhajñāne // SRS_10.88 //
children.translated_text: immeasurable hundreds of thousands of beings become determined and fixed in <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge.' // SRS_10.88 //

children.text: bahu imi sugatasya pratihāryā na sukaru vaktu ca kalpakoṭiyebhiḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Many are these miracles of the <s>Sugata</s> — they cannot easily be told in <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>;

children.text: puravara praviśanti nāyakasmin pramudita sarva jagajjinapraveśe // SRS_10.89 //
children.translated_text: when the Leader enters the excellent city, all the world rejoices at the <s>Jina</s>'s entry.' // SRS_10.89 //

children.text: imi guṇa sugatasya aprameyā naravṛṣabhasya guṇāgrapāragasya /
children.translated_text: 'These immeasurable virtues of the <s>Sugata</s>, the Bull among men, who has reached the far shore of all supreme qualities,

children.text: sarvaguṇaviśeṣapāragasya śirasi namasyatha buddhapuṇyakṣetram // SRS_10.90 //
children.translated_text: who has reached the far shore of all special qualities — bow your heads and pay homage to this field of <s>Buddha</s>-merit!' // SRS_10.90 //

body.text: iti śrīsamādhirāje purapraveśaparivarto nāma daśamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thus ends the tenth chapter in the noble <s>Samādhirāja</s>, called the <s>Purapraveśa</s> (Entry into the City) chapter.

body.text:
(Vaidya 68)
11 Sūtradhāraṇaparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 68) Chapter 11: The <s>Sūtradhāraṇa</s> (Upholding the <s>Sūtra</s>).

body.text: atha khalu bhagavāṃścandraprabhasya kumārabhūtasya niviśanarathyāmavagāhamānaścandraprabhasya kumārabhūtasya niveśanaṃ praviṣṭo 'bhūt | praviśya ca nyaṣīdat prajñapta evāsane | yathārhe cāsane bodhisattvasaṃgho bhikṣusaṃghaśca niṣaṇṇo 'bhūt | atha khalu candraprabhaḥ kumārabhūto bhagavantaṃ bodhisattvasaṃghaṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ ca niṣaṇṇaṃ viditvā svayameva śatarasena bhojanena praṇītena prabhūtena khādanīyena bhojanīyena lehyena coṣyeṇa peyena bhagavantaṃ saṃtarpya saṃpravārya bhagavantaṃ bhuktavantamapanītadhautapāṇiṃ viditvā divyena navanavatikoṭīśatasahasramūlyena dūṣyayugena bhagavantamabhicchādayāmāsa | teṣāṃ ca bodhisattvānāṃ bhikṣusaṃghasya ca pratyekaṃ pratyekaṃ tricīvaramadātū ||
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, entering the residential street of the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>, entered the dwelling of the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>. Having entered, he sat down on a prepared seat. The assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and the community of monks also sat on appropriate seats. Then the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>, knowing that the Blessed One, the assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, and the community of monks were seated, himself with a hundred-flavored meal — excellent, abundant — with hard food, soft food, food to be licked, food to be sucked, and food to be drunk, satisfied and satiated the Blessed One. Knowing that the Blessed One had eaten and his hands were washed and put away, he covered the Blessed One with a divine pair of garments worth ninety <s>koṭi</s>-hundreds of thousands. And to those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and the community of monks, he gave to each and every one a set of three robes.

body.text: atha khalu candraprabhaḥ kumārabhūta ekāṃsamuttarāsaṅga kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantaṃ gāthābhigītena praśnaṃ paripṛcchati sma -
body.translated_text: Then the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>, having arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, having placed his right knee on the ground, bowing his head at the Blessed One's feet, with palms joined toward the Blessed One, questioned the Blessed One with verses:

children.text: kathaṃ caranto vidu bodhisattvaḥ svabhāvu dharmāṇa sadā prajānate /
children.translated_text: 'How should the wise <s>Bodhisattva</s> conduct himself so that he always knows the own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>?

children.text: kathaṃ kriyāmācarate vicakṣaṇaḥ kriyāmācarate bhotāru vadāhi nāyaka // SRS_11.1 //
children.translated_text: How does the discerning one carry out action? How does he carry out action? Tell me, O Leader!' // SRS_11.1 //

children.text: kathaṃ ca jātismaru bhoti nāyaka na cāpi garbhe upapadyate katham /
children.translated_text: 'How does the Leader become one who remembers past lives? And how does he not take rebirth in a womb?

children.text: kathaṃ parīvāru bhavedabhedya pratibhānu bhotīha kathamanantakam // SRS_11.2 //
children.translated_text: How may his retinue become unbreakable? And how does his eloquence become infinite?' // SRS_11.2 //

children.text: sarveṣa sattvāna cariṃ prajānase sarveṣu dharmeṣu ti jñānu vartate /
children.translated_text: 'You know the conduct of all beings; your knowledge operates in all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: anābhibhūtā dvipadānamuttamā pṛcchāmi praśnaṃ mama vyākarohi // SRS_11.3 //
children.translated_text: O unconquered, supreme among bipeds — I ask a question; answer me!' // SRS_11.3 //

children.text: svabhāva dharmāṇamabhāvu jānase anābhilapyāṃ gira saṃprabhāṣase /
children.translated_text: 'You know the own-nature of <s>dharmas</s> as non-existence; you speak inexpressible words;

children.text: siṃhena vā dharṣita sarva kroṣṭakā stathaiva buddheniha anyatīrthikāḥ // SRS_11.4 //
children.translated_text: just as a lion terrifies all jackals — so does the <s>Buddha</s> [terrify] the other sectarians here!' // SRS_11.4 //

children.text: (Vaidya 69)
children.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 69)

children.text: sarveṣa sattvāna cariṃ prajānase sarveṣu dharmeṣu jñānānuvartate /
children.translated_text: 'You know the conduct of all beings; your knowledge operates in all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: asaṅgajñānī pariśuddhagocarā taṃ vyākarohi mama dharmasvāmī // SRS_11.5 //
children.translated_text: of unobstructed knowledge, of purified range — O Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, explain that to me!' // SRS_11.5 //

children.text: atītu jānāsi tathā anāgataṃ yacca ihā vartati pratyutpannam /
children.translated_text: 'You know the past, likewise the future, and also what exists in the present;

children.text: triyadhvajñānaṃ ti asaṅgu vartate tenāhu pṛcchāmiha śākyasiṃham // SRS_11.6 //
children.translated_text: your knowledge of the three times operates without obstruction — therefore I ask the Lion of the <s>Śākyas</s>!' // SRS_11.6 //

children.text: triyadhvayuktāna jināna dharmatā tvaṃ dharmatāṃ jānasi dharmarāja /
children.translated_text: 'The <s>dharmatā</s> (true nature) of the <s>Jinas</s> connected with the three times — you, O <s>Dharma</s>-king, know that <s>dharmatā</s>;

children.text: dharmasvabhāvakuśalaḥ svayaṃbhūstenāhu pṛcchāmiha jñānasāgaram // SRS_11.7 //
children.translated_text: skilled in the own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>, Self-Arisen — therefore I ask this ocean of knowledge!' // SRS_11.7 //

children.text: yat kiṃci dharmaṃ skhalitaṃ na te 'sti tato ti cittaṃ nikhilaṃ prahīṇam /
children.translated_text: 'There is no stumbling whatsoever in your <s>Dharma</s>; therefore all mental rigidity has been abandoned by you;

children.text: prahīṇa granthā khilamohasādakā deśehi me bodhicariṃ narendra // SRS_11.8 //
children.translated_text: the knots, rigidities, delusions, and obstructions have been abandoned — teach me the conduct of awakening, O Lord of men!' // SRS_11.8 //

children.text: yallakṣaṇā dharma jinena buddhāstallakṣaṇaṃ dharma mama prakāśaya /
children.translated_text: 'The characteristic by which <s>dharmas</s> are awakened to by <s>Jinas</s> — reveal that characteristic of <s>dharmas</s> to me;

children.text: yallakṣaṇaṃ dharmamahaṃ viditvā tallakṣaṇaṃ bodhi cariṣyi cārikām // SRS_11.9 //
children.translated_text: knowing that characteristic of <s>dharmas</s>, I shall practice the conduct of awakening with that very characteristic!' // SRS_11.9 //

children.text: vilakṣaṇāṃ sattvacarīmanantāṃ kathaṃ carantaścarimotaranti /
children.translated_text: 'The infinitely varied conduct of beings — how do those who practice it cross over [saṃsāra]?

children.text: carīpraveśaṃ mama deśaya svayaṃ śrutvā ca sattvāna cariṃ prajāniyām // SRS_11.10 //
children.translated_text: Teach me yourself the entrance into [understanding beings'] conduct; having heard, may I know the conduct of beings!' // SRS_11.10 //

children.text: vilakṣaṇaṃ dharmasvabhāvalakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvaśūnyaṃ prakṛtīviviktam /
children.translated_text: 'The varied <s>Dharma</s> whose characteristic is own-nature — empty by own-nature, isolated by nature —

children.text: pratyakṣa bhonti katha bodhisattvaḥ prakāśayasva mama buddhanetrīm // SRS_11.11 //
children.translated_text: how does a <s>Bodhisattva</s> directly perceive [it]? Reveal to me the <s>Buddha</s>-eye!' // SRS_11.11 //

children.text: sarveṣu dharmeṣviha pāramiṃgatāḥ sarveṣu nirdeśapadeṣu śikṣitāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Those who have gone beyond in all <s>dharmas</s>, trained in all modes of teaching,

children.text: (Vaidya 70)
children.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 70)

children.text: niḥsaṃśayī saṃśayakāṅkṣakṣachedake prakāśayāhī mama buddhabodhim // SRS_11.12 //
children.translated_text: free from doubt, cutters of doubt and perplexity — reveal to me <s>Buddha</s>-<s>bodhi</s>!' // SRS_11.12 //

body.text: atha khalu bhagavāṃścandraprabhasya kumārabhūtasya cetasaiva cetaḥparivitarkamājñātha candraprabhaṃ kumārabhūtamāmantrayate smaekadharmeṇa kumāra samanvāgato bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ etān guṇān pratilabhate, kṣipraṃ cānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyate | katamenaikena dharmeṇa iha kumāra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti?kathaṃ ca kumāra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ jānāti? iha kumāra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvadharmānanāmakān nāmāpagatān prajānāti | ghoṣāpagatān vākpathāpagatān akṣarāpagatān utpādāpagatān nirodhāpagatān hetuvilakṣaṇān pratyayavilakṣaṇān vipākalakṣaṇānārambhaṇalakṣaṇān vivekalakṣaṇān ekalakṣaṇān yadutālakṣaṇān nimittāpagatān acintyāṃścintāpagatān manopagatān sarvadharmān yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti | atha khalu bhagavāṃstasyāṃ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata -
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, knowing with his mind the thought and deliberation of the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>'s mind, addressed the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>: "By being endowed with a single <s>dharma</s>, prince, a <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> obtains these qualities and quickly awakens to the unsurpassed, perfect awakening. By which single <s>dharma</s>? Here, prince, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> understands the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s> as they truly are. And how, prince, does the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> know the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s>? Here, prince, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> understands all <s>dharmas</s> as nameless, devoid of names, devoid of sound, devoid of speech-paths, devoid of syllables, devoid of arising, devoid of cessation, different from causes, different from conditions, having the mark of [karmic] result, having the mark of [non-]grasping, having the mark of seclusion, having a single mark — namely, the mark of no-mark — devoid of signs, inconceivable, devoid of thought, devoid of mind. He understands all <s>dharmas</s> as they truly are." Then the Blessed One, at that time, spoke these verses —

children.text: eku nirdeśa dharmāṇāṃ sarvadharmā alakṣaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: "A single exposition of <s>dharmas</s>: all <s>dharmas</s> are without characteristics —

children.text: deśitā varaprajñena yathābhūtaṃ prajānatā // SRS_11.13 //
children.translated_text: thus taught by the one of supreme wisdom, who knows things as they truly are. // SRS_11.13 //

children.text: ya evaṃ dharmanirdeśaṃ bodhisattvaḥ prajānati /
children.translated_text: "The <s>Bodhisattva</s> who understands this exposition of <s>dharmas</s> —

children.text: na tasya bhoti viṣṭhānaṃ sūtrakoṭyā prabhāṣataḥ // SRS_11.14 //
children.translated_text: for him there is no exhaustion, even when speaking <s>koṭis</s> of <s>sūtras</s>! // SRS_11.14 //

children.text: adhiṣṭhito nāyako hi bhūtakoṭīṃ prajānati /
children.translated_text: "Empowered by the Guide, he knows the limit of reality;

children.text: prajānāti ca tāṃ koṭīṃ na cātro kiṃci bhāṣitam // SRS_11.15 //
children.translated_text: and he knows that limit, yet nothing at all is spoken there! // SRS_11.15 //

children.text: ekena sarvaṃ jānāti sarvamekana paśyati /
children.translated_text: "By one [thing] he knows all, and through all he sees the one;

children.text: kiyad bahuṃ pu bhāṣitvā na tasyotpadyate mahaḥ // SRS_11.16 //
children.translated_text: however much he may speak, no pride arises in him! // SRS_11.16 //

children.text: tathāsya cittaṃ nidhyāptaṃ sarvadharmā anāmakāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Thus his mind is firmly settled: all <s>dharmas</s> are nameless;

children.text: śikṣito nāmanirdeśe bhūtāṃ vācaṃ prabhāṣate // SRS_11.17 //
children.translated_text: trained in the exposition of names, he speaks words that are true!" // SRS_11.17 //

children.text: śṛṇoti ghoṣaṃ yaṃ kaṃcit pūrvāntaṃ tasya jānati /
children.translated_text: "Whatever sound he hears, he knows its prior [nature];

children.text: jñātvā ghoṣasya pūrvāntaṃ ghoṣeṇa hriyate na saḥ // SRS_11.18 //
children.translated_text: having known the prior nature of sound, he is not carried away by sound! // SRS_11.18 //

children.text: yathā ghoṣasya pūrvāntaṃ evaṃ dharmāṇa lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: "As is the prior nature of sound, so is the characteristic of <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: evaṃ dharmān prajānanto na garbheṣūpapadyate // SRS_11.19 //
children.translated_text: one who knows <s>dharmas</s> thus is not reborn in a womb! // SRS_11.19 //

children.text: ajātiḥ sarvadharmāṇāmanutpattiṃ prajānati /
children.translated_text: "Understanding the non-birth of all <s>dharmas</s>, he knows their non-arising;

children.text: prajānan jātinirdeśaṃ bhavejjātismaraḥ sadā // SRS_11.20 //
children.translated_text: yet knowing the exposition of birth, he is always one who remembers his [former] births! // SRS_11.20 //

children.text: yadā jātismaro bhoti tadā ca carate kriyām /
children.translated_text: "When he remembers his births, then he engages in action;

children.text: kriyāmotaramāṇasya parivāro na bhidyate // SRS_11.21 //
children.translated_text: for one who transcends action, his retinue is not broken!" // SRS_11.21 //

children.text: (Vaidya 71)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 71)

children.text: yaṃ evaṃ śūnyakān dharmān bodhisattvaḥ prajānati /
children.translated_text: "When the <s>Bodhisattva</s> thus knows <s>dharmas</s> to be empty,

children.text: na tasya kiṃcidajñātameṣā koṭirakiṃcanā // SRS_11.22 //
children.translated_text: nothing remains unknown to him — this is the limit of possessing nothing! // SRS_11.22 //

children.text: akiṃcanāyāṃ koṭyāṃ hi kiṃcid bālairvikalpitam /
children.translated_text: "At this limit of possessing nothing, something is imagined by fools;

children.text: yena te kalpakoṭīyaḥ saṃsaranti punaḥ punaḥ // SRS_11.23 //
children.translated_text: because of which they wander in <s>saṃsāra</s> for <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, again and again! // SRS_11.23 //

children.text: sacette kalpa jānīyuryathā jānati nāyakaḥ /
children.translated_text: "If they were to know conceptualization as the Guide knows it,

children.text: na teṣāṃ duḥkhu jāyeta nāpi gaccheyu durgatim // SRS_11.24 //
children.translated_text: suffering would not arise for them, nor would they go to evil destinies! // SRS_11.24 //

children.text: evaṃ pṛthagjanāḥ sarve ajānanta imaṃ nayam /
children.translated_text: "Thus all ordinary beings, not knowing this method,

children.text: kṣipanti īdṛśān dharmān yatra duḥkhaṃ nirudhyate // SRS_11.25 //
children.translated_text: reject such <s>dharmas</s> — those wherein suffering ceases! // SRS_11.25 //

children.text: alabdhiḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmasaṃjñā pravartate /
children.translated_text: "When all <s>dharmas</s> are not apprehended, the perception of <s>dharma</s> proceeds;

children.text: sā evaṃjātikā saṃjñā saṃjñāmeva vijānatha // SRS_11.26 //
children.translated_text: that perception arises in just this way — know that perception to be merely perception! // SRS_11.26 //

children.text: vijānanā ca saṃjñā ca bālairetadvikalpitam /
children.translated_text: "Knowing and perceiving — these are imagined by fools;

children.text: prakalpiteṣu dharmeṣu nātra muhyanti paṇḍitāḥ // SRS_11.27 //
children.translated_text: regarding imagined <s>dharmas</s>, the wise are not confused! // SRS_11.27 //

children.text: paṇḍitānāmiyaṃ bhūmirbālānāṃ nātra gocaraḥ /
children.translated_text: "This is the ground of the wise; it is not the domain of fools;

children.text: gocaro buddhaputrāṇāṃ śūnyā dharmā anāvilāḥ // SRS_11.28 //
children.translated_text: the domain of the sons of the <s>Buddha</s> is empty <s>dharmas</s>, unstained! // SRS_11.28 //

children.text: bodhisattvānāmiyaṃ bhūmirbuddhaputracarī iyam /
children.translated_text: "This is the ground of the <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, the conduct of the sons of the <s>Buddha</s>;

children.text: buddhadharmāṇalaṃkāro deśitā śānta śūnyatā // SRS_11.29 //
children.translated_text: the ornament of <s>Buddha</s>-qualities — the peaceful emptiness has been taught! // SRS_11.29 //

children.text: yadā ca bodhisattvānāṃ prahīṇā bhoti vāsanā /
children.translated_text: "When the latent tendencies of the <s>Bodhisattvas</s> have been abandoned,

children.text: na te hriyanti rūpehi buddhagotrasmi te sthitāḥ // SRS_11.30 //
children.translated_text: they are not carried away by forms — they are established in the <s>Buddha</s>-lineage! // SRS_11.30 //

children.text: asthāna sarvadharmāṇāṃ sthānameṣāṃ na vidyate /
children.translated_text: "All <s>dharmas</s> are without a standing-place; no standing-place for them is found;

children.text: ya evaṃ sthāna jānāti bodhistasya na durlabhā // SRS_11.31 //
children.translated_text: whoever knows the standing-place thus — <s>bodhi</s> is not difficult for him! // SRS_11.31 //

children.text: dānaṃ śīlaṃ śrutaṃ kṣāntiṃ sevitvā mitra bhadrakān /
children.translated_text: "Having practiced generosity, morality, learning, patience, and cultivated excellent friends,

children.text: imāṃ kriyāṃ vijānantaḥ kṣipraṃ bodhiṃ sa budhyate // SRS_11.32 //
children.translated_text: those who know this action quickly awaken to <s>bodhi</s>! // SRS_11.32 //

children.text: devātha nāgāḥ sada satkaronti gandharva yakṣā asurā mahoragāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Gods and <s>Nāgas</s> always honor him, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Asuras</s>, and <s>Mahoragas</s>;

children.text: sarve ca rājāna suparṇi kinnarā niśācarāścāsya karonti pūjām // SRS_11.33 //
children.translated_text: all kings, <s>Suparṇas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>, and night-roaming [beings] perform worship to him! // SRS_11.33 //

children.text: yaśo 'sya bhāṣanti ca buddhakoṭiyo bahukalpakoṭyo 'pi adhiṣṭhihantaḥ /
children.translated_text: "<s>Koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s> proclaim his fame, empowering him for many <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>;

children.text: (Vaidya 72)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 72)

children.text: dharma prakāśantiya bhoti varṇo na śakyu paryantu kṣapetu tasya // SRS_11.34 //
children.translated_text: when he illuminates the <s>Dharma</s>, there is praise — an end to it cannot be exhausted! // SRS_11.34 //

children.text: yaḥ śūnyatāṃ jānati bodhisattvaḥ karoti so 'rthaṃ bahuprāṇikoṭinām /
children.translated_text: "The <s>Bodhisattva</s> who knows emptiness serves the purpose of many <s>koṭis</s> of beings;

children.text: deśeti dharmaṃ paryāyasūtrato śrutvāsya prema janayanti gauravam // SRS_11.35 //
children.translated_text: he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> from the <s>sūtras</s> — hearing him, they generate affection and reverence! // SRS_11.35 //

children.text: jñānaṃ ca teṣāṃ vipulaṃ pravartate yeneti paśyanti narottamān jinān /
children.translated_text: "And vast knowledge arises in them, by which they behold the supreme <s>Jinas</s>, the best of men;

children.text: kṣetre ca paśyanti viyūha śobhanaṃ dharmaṃ ca deśenti te lokanāthāḥ // SRS_11.36 //
children.translated_text: and they behold the splendid displays in [Buddha-]fields, and those Lords of the World teach the <s>Dharma</s>! // SRS_11.36 //

children.text: māyopamān jānatha sarvadharmān yathāntarīkṣaṃ prakṛtīya śūnyam /
children.translated_text: "Know all <s>dharmas</s> to be like an illusion, empty by nature like the atmosphere;

children.text: prakṛtiṃ pi so jānati teṣa tādṛśīmevaṃ caranto na kahiṃci sajjati // SRS_11.37 //
children.translated_text: and he knows their nature to be just so — one who conducts himself thus is attached nowhere! // SRS_11.37 //

children.text: jñānenāsaṅgena karoti so 'rthaṃ loke caranto varabodhicārikām /
children.translated_text: "With unattached knowledge he serves the world, conducting the supreme <s>Bodhisattva</s>-career in the world;

children.text: jñānena te vīkṣiya sarvadharmān preṣenti te nirmita anyakṣetrān // SRS_11.38 //
children.translated_text: having examined all <s>dharmas</s> through knowledge, they send forth emanations to other fields! // SRS_11.38 //

children.text: te buddhakṛtyaṃ kariyāṇa nirmitā prakṛtīya gacchanti yathaiva dharmatām /
children.translated_text: "Having accomplished <s>Buddha</s>-work, those emanations return to their original nature, the <s>dharmatā</s>;

children.text: yathābhiprāyaṃ ca labhanti te 'rthaṃ ye bodhicittasmi narāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ // SRS_11.39 //
children.translated_text: and those persons established in <s>bodhicitta</s> obtain their purpose as they wish! // SRS_11.39 //

children.text: sa bhoti buddhān sadā kṛtajño yo buddhavaṃśasya sthitīya yujyate /
children.translated_text: "He is always grateful to the <s>Buddhas</s> — one who is yoked to the continuity of the <s>Buddha</s>-lineage;

children.text: virocamānena samucchrayeṇa dvātriṃśa kāye 'sya bhavanti lakṣaṇāḥ // SRS_11.40 //
children.translated_text: with radiant splendor, the thirty-two marks appear on his body! // SRS_11.40 //

children.text: anyānanantān bahu ānuśaṃsān śreṣṭhaṃ samādhau caramāṇu lapsyate /
children.translated_text: "And he will obtain other innumerable, abundant benefits, supreme, while practicing this <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: mahābalo bhoti sadā akampiyo rājān tasyo na sahanti tejaḥ // SRS_11.41 //
children.translated_text: he is always of great strength and unshakable — kings cannot bear his splendor! // SRS_11.41 //

children.text: (Vaidya 73)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 73)

children.text: prāsādiko bhoti mahābhiṣaṭkaḥ puṇyena tejena śirīya codgataḥ /
children.translated_text: "He becomes majestic, greatly anointed, risen through merit, splendor, and glory;

children.text: devāpi no tasya sahanti tejo yo buddhadharmeṣu careya paṇḍitaḥ // SRS_11.42 //
children.translated_text: even gods cannot bear his splendor — the wise one who practices the <s>Buddha</s>-qualities! // SRS_11.42 //

children.text: mitraṃ sa bhoti sada sarvaprāṇināṃ yo bodhicittasmi dṛḍhaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: "He is always a friend of all living beings — one firmly established in <s>bodhicitta</s>;

children.text: na cāndhakāro 'sya kadāci bhoti prakāśayantasmi sa buddhabodhim // SRS_11.43 //
children.translated_text: and darkness never exists for him who illuminates the <s>Buddha</s>'s awakening! // SRS_11.43 //

children.text: apagatagiravākpathā anabhilapyā yatha gaganaṃ tatha tāḥ svabhāvadharmāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Gone beyond the path of speech, inexpressible — like space, such are the own-nature <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: ima gati paramāṃ vijānamāno tatha tu bhavati pratibhānu akṣayaṃ se // SRS_11.44 //
children.translated_text: knowing this supreme course, his eloquence becomes inexhaustible! // SRS_11.44 //

children.text: sūtraśatasahasra bhāṣamāṇaḥ sūkṣma prajānati pūrvikāṃ sa koṭim /
children.translated_text: "While speaking hundreds of thousands of <s>sūtras</s>, he knows the subtle prior limit;

children.text: sada vidu bhavatī asaṅgavākyaḥ susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.45 //
children.translated_text: he is always wise, with unattached speech, knowing the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.45 //

children.text: nayaśatakuśalaśca nityu bhoti bahuvidhaghoṣaniruktikovidaśca /
children.translated_text: "He is always skilled in hundreds of methods, and expert in manifold utterances and etymologies;

children.text: karmaphalavibhakti niścitāśco bhonti viśiṣṭa viśeṣa evarūpāḥ // SRS_11.46 //
children.translated_text: and he is certain in the classification of <s>karmic</s> fruits — of such a kind are his eminent distinctions! // SRS_11.46 //

children.text: avikalaveśadhārī bhoti daśabalaātmaja paṇḍito mahātmā /
children.translated_text: "He wears the complete attire, this wise, great-souled son of the <s>Daśabala</s>;

children.text: sada sbhṛti pariśuddha tasya bhoti susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.47 //
children.translated_text: his mindfulness is always pure, knowing the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.47 //

children.text: na śruṇati amanojña śabda jātu śruṇati praṇīta manāpu nitya śabdān /
children.translated_text: "He never hears disagreeable sounds; he always hears sublime, pleasant sounds;

children.text: sada bhavati manojña tasya vācā susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.48 //
children.translated_text: his speech is always agreeable, knowing the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.48 //

children.text: smṛtimatigatiprajñavantu bhoti tathapi ca cittamanāvilaṃ prasannam /
children.translated_text: "He possesses mindfulness, intelligence, insight, and wisdom, and his mind is untroubled and serene;

children.text: (Vaidya 74)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 74)

children.text: sūtraśatasahasru bhāṣate anekān susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.49 //
children.translated_text: he speaks hundreds of thousands of <s>sūtras</s>, knowing the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.49 //

children.text: akṣarapadaprabhedakovidaśco ruta bahu jānati naika anyamanye /
children.translated_text: "He is skilled in the analysis of syllables and words, and knows many different sounds and their meanings;

children.text: arthakuśala bhoti vyañjano ca ima guṇa dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.50 //
children.translated_text: he is skilled in meaning and in syllables — these are the qualities of one who knows the own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.50 //

children.text: devamanujanāgarākṣasānām asuramahoragakinnarāṇa nityam /
children.translated_text: "Of gods, humans, <s>Nāgas</s>, <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Asuras</s>, <s>Mahoragas</s>, and <s>Kinnaras</s> —

children.text: teṣa sada priya manāpa bhoti susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.51 //
children.translated_text: he is always dear and agreeable to them, knowing the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.51 //

children.text: bhūtagaṇapiśācarākṣasāśco paramasudāruṇa ye ca māṃsabhakṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Hosts of <s>bhūtas</s>, <s>piśācas</s>, and <s>rākṣasas</s> — even those supremely ferocious flesh-eaters —

children.text: te 'sya bhayu na jātu saṃjanenti susukhuma dharmasvabhāvu jānamānaḥ // SRS_11.52 //
children.translated_text: never generate fear toward him, who knows the exceedingly subtle own-nature of <s>dharmas</s>! // SRS_11.52 //

children.text: vipula kathaṃ śruṇitva paṇḍitānāṃ vipula prajāyati romaharṣa teṣām /
children.translated_text: "Having heard the vast discourse of the wise, vast hair-raising [joy] arises in them;

children.text: vipula tada janenti buddhapremaṃ vipula acintiyu teṣu bhoti arthaḥ // SRS_11.53 //
children.translated_text: vast affection for the <s>Buddha</s> is then generated in them, and vast, inconceivable benefit arises! // SRS_11.53 //

children.text: puṇyabala na śakyu teṣa vaktuṃ bahumapi kalpasahasra bhāṣamāṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: "The power of their merit cannot be told, even by those speaking for many thousands of <s>kalpas</s>;

children.text: aparimita ananta aprameya imu sugatāna dharetva dharmagañjam // SRS_11.54 //
children.translated_text: immeasurable, infinite, beyond measure — [such is the merit of] retaining this <s>Dharma</s>-treasury of the <s>Sugatas</s>! // SRS_11.54 //

children.text: sarva jina atīta pūjitāste aparimitā ya anāgatāśca buddhāḥ /
children.translated_text: "All past <s>Jinas</s> were worshipped by them, and the immeasurable <s>Buddhas</s> yet to come;

children.text: daśasu diśāsu ye sthitāśca buddhā ima vara śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_11.55 //
children.translated_text: and those <s>Buddhas</s> established in the ten directions — [all through] retaining this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_11.55 //

children.text: yatha naru iha kaści puṇyakāmo daśabala kāruṇikānupasthiheyyā /
children.translated_text: "Just as a man here, desiring merit, might attend upon the <s>Daśabala</s>, the compassionate ones,

children.text: aparimita ananta kalpakoṭīraparimitaṃ ca janetu prema teṣu // SRS_11.56 //
children.translated_text: for immeasurable, infinite <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, and generate immeasurable affection for them — // SRS_11.56 //

children.text: (Vaidya 75)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 75)

children.text: dvitīya naru bhaveta puṇyakāmo itu paramārthanayāttu gāthamekām /
children.translated_text: "a second man, desiring merit, [might retain] even a single verse of the ultimate meaning from this;

children.text: dhariya carimakāli vartamāne parimaku puṇyakalā na bhoti tasya // SRS_11.57 //
children.translated_text: retaining it in the latter age, the present time — the measure of his merit is without limit! // SRS_11.57 //

children.text: parama iyaṃ viśiṣṭa buddhapūjā carimaki dāruṇi kāli vartamāne /
children.translated_text: "This is the supreme, eminent worship of the <s>Buddha</s>: in the latter, dreadful age, in the present time,

children.text: catupadamita gāthameku śrutvā dhārayi pūjita tena sarvabuddhāḥ // SRS_11.58 //
children.translated_text: hearing and retaining even a single four-line verse — by that, all <s>Buddhas</s> are worshipped! // SRS_11.58 //

children.text: parama sada sulabdha tehi lābhā parama subhuktu sadā va rāṣṭrapiṇḍam /
children.translated_text: "Supremely well-gained is their gain always; supreme is their enjoyment of alms-food from the realm;

children.text: parama daśabalasya jyeṣṭhaputrā bahu jina pūjita tehi dīrgharātram // SRS_11.59 //
children.translated_text: they are supremely the eldest sons of the <s>Daśabala</s> — many <s>Jinas</s> have been worshipped by them for a long time! // SRS_11.59 //

children.text: ahamapi iha dṛṣṭa gṛghrakūṭe tatha maya vyākṛta te 'pi buddhajñāne /
children.translated_text: "I too have been beheld [by them] here on <s>Gṛdhrakūṭa</s> (Vulture Peak); and I have predicted them for <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge;

children.text: api ca maya parītu maitraka syāṃ punarapi vyākaraṇāya tasmi kāle // SRS_11.60 //
children.translated_text: and I shall be surrounded by loving-kindness — and [I shall give] a prediction again at that time! // SRS_11.60 //

children.text: tatha punaramitāyu teṣa tatro bhāṣate buddha aneka ānuśaṃsām /
children.translated_text: "And the <s>Buddha</s>, of immeasurable lifespan there, speaks many benefits;

children.text: sarvi imi sukhāvatīṃ praviṣṭo abhirati gatva akṣobhya paśyi buddham // SRS_11.61 //
children.translated_text: all these will enter <s>Sukhāvatī</s>, and going to <s>Abhirati</s>, will behold <s>Akṣobhya</s> <s>Buddha</s>! // SRS_11.61 //

children.text: kalpaśatasahasra aprameyā na ca vinipātabhayaṃ kadāci bhoti /
children.translated_text: "For immeasurable hundreds of thousands of <s>kalpas</s>, the fear of downfall will never arise;

children.text: imu varu caramāṇu bodhicaryāmanubhavati sa hi nitya saumanasyam // SRS_11.62 //
children.translated_text: practicing this supreme conduct of awakening, he will always experience joy! // SRS_11.62 //

children.text: tasya imu viśiṣṭa evarūpā ya imu prakāśita śreṣṭha ānuśaṃsām /
children.translated_text: "Such are his eminent distinctions — the supreme benefits have been proclaimed;

children.text: pratipadamanuśikṣamāṇa mahyaṃ paścimi kāli dhareyu eta sūtram // SRS_11.63 //
children.translated_text: may those who train following my teaching retain this <s>sūtra</s> in the latter age!" // SRS_11.63 //

body.text: iti śrīsamādhirāje sūtradhāraṇaparivarto nāmaikādaśaḥ || 11 ||
body.translated_text: Thus ends the eleventh chapter of the noble <s>Samādhirāja</s>, named "The Chapter on Retaining the <s>Sūtra</s>" (<s>Sūtradhāraṇaparivarta</s>). // 11 //

body.text:
(Vaidya 76)
12 Samādhyanuśikṣaṇāparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 76) Chapter 12: The Chapter on Training in <s>Samādhi</s> (<s>Samādhyanuśikṣaṇāparivarta</s>).

body.text: tatra kumāra yo bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvadhamāṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ prajānāti, tasyeme evaṃrūpā guṇānuśaṃsā bhavanti - sa tathāgatānāṃ bhūtaṃ guṇavarṇaṃ bhāṣate | na ca tathāgatān vyākhyāti asatā abhūtena | tat kasya hetoḥ? yayā dharmatayā tathāgataḥ prabhāvyate, tāṃ dharmatāṃ yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti | anantāt buddhaguṇān prajānāti | tat kasya hetoḥ? anantā hi kumāra buddhaguṇā acintyāścintāpagatāḥ | tenāśakyaṃ cintayituṃ vā pramātuṃ vā | tat kasya hetoḥ? cittaṃ hi kumāra niḥsvabhāvamarūpyanidarśanam | iti hi kumāra yatsvabhāvaṃ cittaṃ tatsvabhāvā buddhaguṇāḥ, yatsvabhāvā buddhaguṇāstatsvabhāvāstathāgatāḥ, tatsvabhāvāḥ sarvadharmāḥ | yaḥ kumāra bodhisattvo mahāsattva evaṃ sarvaguṇasvabhāvanirdeśaṃ yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti, ayaṃ kumāra ucyate bodhisattvo mahāsattvo nidhyāptimānasaḥ | niḥsaraṇakuśalaḥ | traidhātukaniḥsaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti | yathāvadarśī avitathavādī ananyathābhāṣī, yathāvādī tathākārī, anabhiniviṣṭastraidhātuke traidhātukasamatikrāntaḥ | samatikrāntaḥ kāmabhūmiṃ rūpabhūmiṃ ārūpyabhūmiṃ kleśabhūmiṃ nāmabhūmiṃ ghoṣabhūmim | akṣarapadanayakuśalaḥ | akṣaravibhāvitajñānaḥ | anabhilapyadharmakovidaḥ | akṣarajñaḥ | akṣarakuśalaḥ | akṣarapadaprabhedajñānakuśalaḥ | akṣarapadaprabhedavistārajñānakuśalaḥ | sarvadharmapadaprabhedakuśalaḥ | sarvadharmapadaprabhedavistārakuśalaḥ | sarvadharmavyavasthānajñānakuśalaḥ | niścitayā buddhyā samanvāgato 'nabhibhūtaḥ sarvamāraiḥ pāpīyobhirmārakāyikābhiśca devatābhiḥ ||
body.translated_text: Therein, O prince, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> who comprehends the inherent nature of all <s>dharmas</s> — for him these are the advantages and benefits: he speaks the true description of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>' qualities; he does not explain the <s>Tathāgatas</s> with what is false and untrue. Why? He truly comprehends the <s>dharmatā</s> by which the <s>Tathāgata</s> is characterized. He comprehends the infinite <s>Buddha</s>-qualities. Why? For, O prince, the <s>Buddha</s>-qualities are infinite, inconceivable, beyond thought. Therefore they cannot be thought about or measured. Why? For, O prince, the mind is without inherent nature, formless, without indication. Thus, O prince, whatever is the inherent nature of the mind, that is the inherent nature of the <s>Buddha</s>-qualities; whatever is the inherent nature of the <s>Buddha</s>-qualities, that is the inherent nature of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>; that is the inherent nature of all <s>dharmas</s>. The <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s>, O prince, who truly comprehends this exposition of the inherent nature of all qualities — he, O prince, is called a <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> of contemplative mind, skilled in escape. He truly comprehends the escape from the three realms. He is one who sees things as they are, speaks without falsehood, speaks without contradiction; as he speaks so he acts; he is unattached to the three realms and has transcended the three realms. He has transcended the realm of desire, the realm of form, the formless realm, the realm of <s>kleśas</s>, the realm of name, and the realm of sound. He is skilled in syllables, words, and methods; his knowledge is illuminated through syllables; he is expert in the inexpressible <s>Dharma</s>; he knows syllables; he is skilled in syllables; skilled in the knowledge of the differentiation of syllables and words; skilled in the knowledge of the expansion of the differentiation of syllables and words; skilled in the differentiation of all <s>dharma</s>-words; skilled in the expansion of the differentiation of all <s>dharma</s>-words; skilled in the knowledge of the establishment of all <s>dharmas</s>. He is endowed with certain wisdom and is unconquered by all <s>Māras</s>, the Evil Ones, and the deities of <s>Māra</s>'s host. ||

body.text: asmin khalu punardharmaparyāye bhāṣyamāṇe aṣṭānavaterniyutānāṃ devamānuṣikāyāḥ prajāyāḥ pūrvaparikarmakṛtāyāḥ koṭīśatasahasrāvartāyā dhāraṇyā anāvaraṇāyāśca dharmavipaśyanāyāḥ kṣānteḥ pratilambho 'bhūt | te ca sarve bhagavatā vyākṛutā aṣṭācatvāriṃśatā kalpairasaṃkhyeyaśatasahasrairanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbhotsyante | sarve ca anyānyanāmāna ekāyuṣpramāṇā anyānyeṣu buddhakṣetreṣu anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbhotsyante | tatredamucyate -
body.translated_text: When this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse was being spoken, eight hundred and forty-nine <s>niyutas</s> of the divine and human assembly — who had previously made preparations, who had turned through hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭis</s> — attained <s>dhāraṇī</s> and the unobstructed patient acceptance of <s>Dharma</s>-insight. They were all predicted by the Blessed One: in forty-eight <s>kalpas</s> and incalculable hundreds of thousands [thereafter], they would fully awaken to the unsurpassed, perfect awakening. All, under different names, with one lifespan, in various <s>Buddha</s>-fields, would fully awaken to the unsurpassed, perfect awakening. Here the following was said:

children.text: yo bodhisattva matimān prāpnoti anuttarāṃ varāṃ bodhim /
children.translated_text: "The wise <s>Bodhisattva</s> who attains the unsurpassed, excellent awakening —

children.text: arthe ca dharmi kuśalo carati sa dharmasvabhāvasmi // SRS_12.1 //
children.translated_text: skilled in meaning and <s>Dharma</s>, he conducts himself in the inherent nature of <s>dharmas</s>. // SRS_12.1 //

children.text: nābhūt bhaṇati vācaṃ buddhānāṃ yādṛśā guṇaviśeṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: "He does not speak an untrue word about the qualities and excellences of the Buddhas;

children.text: sa hi dharmu taṃ jinānāṃ jānati śūro vigatakaṅkṣāḥ // SRS_12.2 //
children.translated_text: for he knows that <s>Dharma</s> of the <s>Jinas</s> — he is a hero, free from doubt. // SRS_12.2 //

children.text: ekārtha sarvadharmān prajānati ca śūnyatāṃ sa ekāṃśam /
children.translated_text: "He comprehends all <s>dharmas</s> as having one meaning, and emptiness as one-pointed;

children.text: nānārthu nāsti teṣāṃ ekārthe śikṣito bhavati // SRS_12.3 //
children.translated_text: they have no diverse meaning — he is one trained in the single meaning. // SRS_12.3 //

children.text: (Vaidya 77)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 77)

children.text: niṣkalpānavikalpān anopalambhāṃśca jānāti matimān /
children.translated_text: "Without construction, without conceptualization, and non-apprehendable — the wise one knows [them thus];

children.text: kṣati akṣaye 'sya saṃjñā prahīṇa sarvā niravaśeṣā // SRS_12.4 //
children.translated_text: the perception of decay in the undecaying is completely abandoned without remainder. // SRS_12.4 //

children.text: na hi rūpato daśabalān paśyati so dharmakāya narasiṃhān /
children.translated_text: "He does not see the Ten-Powered Ones through form — those lions among men are <s>Dharmakāya</s>;

children.text: nāpi lakṣaṇehi tasya prahīṇa sarve viparyāsāḥ // SRS_12.5 //
children.translated_text: nor [does he see them] through marks — all his distortions are abandoned. // SRS_12.5 //

children.text: dharmā acintya ete cintāpagatā svabhāva upaśāntāḥ /
children.translated_text: "These <s>dharmas</s> are inconceivable, beyond thought, pacified in their inherent nature;

children.text: evaṃ prajānamānaḥ paśyati buddhān dvipadaśreṣṭhān // SRS_12.6 //
children.translated_text: knowing thus, he sees the Buddhas, the best among bipeds. // SRS_12.6 //

children.text: yatha jñātvātmasaṃjñāstathaiva sarvatra preṣitā buddhiḥ /
children.translated_text: "Just as having known the perception of self [to be false], likewise his understanding is directed everywhere;

children.text: sarve ca tatsvabhāvā dharma viśuddhā gaganakalpāḥ // SRS_12.7 //
children.translated_text: all <s>dharmas</s> are of that same nature — pure, like space. // SRS_12.7 //

children.text: na hi jāta mānase 'sya niḥsaraṇaṃ jñātva sarvadharmāṇām /
children.translated_text: "His mind never produces [the thought of] escape, having known [the nature of] all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: traidhātuke vimuktipraṇidhānu na vidyate tasya // SRS_12.8 //
children.translated_text: he has no aspiration for liberation in the three realms. // SRS_12.8 //

children.text: yathāvadarśi bhoti avitathavacano 'nanyathābhāṣī /
children.translated_text: "He sees things as they are, speaks without falsehood, speaks without contradiction;

children.text: sarvaṃ ca tasya vacanaṃ niścarati jinānubhāvena // SRS_12.9 //
children.translated_text: and all his speech issues forth by the power of the <s>Jinas</s>. // SRS_12.9 //

children.text: atikrāntu kāmabhūmiṃ kileśabhūmiṃ ca rūpa ārūpyān /
children.translated_text: "Having transcended the realm of desire, the realm of <s>kleśas</s>, form, and the formless —

children.text: dharmeṣvasaktamanasaḥ pramudita carate jagahitāya // SRS_12.10 //
children.translated_text: with a mind unattached to <s>dharmas</s>, he conducts himself joyfully for the benefit of the world. // SRS_12.10 //

children.text: atikrāntu nāmabhūmiṃ ghoṣo jñāna svabhāvena cayikaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Having transcended the realm of name and sound, his knowledge is accumulated by its own nature;

children.text: yāvacciraṃ pi bhaṇato na vidyate niśrayastasya // SRS_12.11 //
children.translated_text: however long he speaks, there is no basis [of attachment] for him. // SRS_12.11 //

children.text: saṃjñāpracāru nāsti dṛṣṭiviparyāsu sarvaśaḥ kṣīṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: "There is no operation of perception; views and distortions are entirely exhausted;

children.text: suniścitā buddhiśca te gaganopamadhīrāḥ // SRS_12.12 //
children.translated_text: his wisdom is well-established — those steady ones are like space. // SRS_12.12 //

children.text: vihāra koṭīniyutā bhaveyu vikṣepaṇārtha cittasya /
children.translated_text: "Though there be <s>koṭis</s> and <s>niyutas</s> of objects for distracting the mind,

children.text: abhibhavati sarvamārān na cāpi teṣāṃ vaśamupaiti // SRS_12.13 //
children.translated_text: he overcomes all <s>Māras</s> and never comes under their power. // SRS_12.13 //

children.text: sarvi jahyu mārajālaṃ pariśuddhaḥ śīlavānaparidāhaḥ /
children.translated_text: "He has abandoned all of <s>Māra</s>'s net; pure, moral, without torment;

children.text: dhyānasukhasmi nirataḥ prajānati ca śūnyakaṃ lokam // SRS_12.14 //
children.translated_text: delighting in the bliss of <s>dhyāna</s>, he comprehends the world as empty. // SRS_12.14 //

children.text: lokāśca skandha uktāstāṃścāpi sa śūnyakān prajānati /
children.translated_text: "The world is declared to be the <s>skandhas</s> — and those too he comprehends as empty:

children.text: anutpādānanirodhān sarvān gaganopamān dharmān // SRS_12.15 //
children.translated_text: all <s>dharmas</s> are without arising and without cessation, like space. // SRS_12.15 //

children.text: ātmānaṃ sa tyajate na caiva śikṣāṃ śrutāṃ daśabalasya /
children.translated_text: "He relinquishes himself but never the training heard from the Ten-Powered One;

children.text: so śīlapāramiṃ gata upapadyati yatra praṇidheti // SRS_12.16 //
children.translated_text: having gone to the perfection of morality, he is reborn wherever he aspires. // SRS_12.16 //

children.text: vicarantu buddhakṣetrān paśyati buddhakoṭīniyutāni /
children.translated_text: "Wandering through <s>Buddha</s>-fields, he sees <s>niyutas</s> and <s>koṭis</s> of Buddhas;

children.text: na svargaṃ prārthayate na cāpi praṇidhānato muktaḥ // SRS_12.17 //
children.translated_text: he does not seek heaven, nor is he released from his vow. // SRS_12.17 //

children.text: (Vaidya 78)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 78)

children.text: na bhraṃśayati sa vīryaṃ muhūrtamātramapi dharma caramāṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: "He does not lose his vigor even for a moment while practicing the <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: praśaṃsitaśca bhoti buddhabhirdaśadiśe loke // SRS_12.18 //
children.translated_text: and he is praised by the Buddhas in the worlds of the ten directions. // SRS_12.18 //

children.text: tasmāttarhi kumāra śrutvā dharmānimān samādhismin /
children.translated_text: "Therefore, O prince, having heard these <s>dharmas</s> in this <s>samādhi</s>,

children.text: jahiyāna jñātralābhaṃ prakāśaya mahājane dharmam // SRS_12.19 //
children.translated_text: abandon gain from relatives and proclaim the <s>Dharma</s> to the great multitude! // SRS_12.19 //

children.text: ya icchati svayaṃbhūrbhaveya buddho mahāguṇasamaṅgī /
children.translated_text: "He who desires 'I shall become a Self-Arisen <s>Buddha</s>, endowed with great qualities' —

children.text: iha śikṣitvā kuśalo daśabaladhārī bhavati buddhaḥ // SRS_12.20 //
children.translated_text: training here, becoming skilled, bearing the ten powers, he becomes a <s>Buddha</s>. // SRS_12.20 //

body.text: iti śrīsamādhirāje samādhyanuśikṣaṇāparivarto nāma dvādaśaḥ || 12 ||
body.translated_text: Thus ends the twelfth chapter in the noble <s>Samādhirāja</s>, called the <s>Samādhyanuśikṣaṇāparivarta</s> (Chapter on Training in <s>Samādhi</s>). || 12 ||

body.text:
(Vaidya 79)
13 Samādhinirdeśaparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: (Vaidya 79) Chapter 13: <s>Samādhinirdeśaparivarta</s> (The Chapter on the Exposition of <s>Samādhi</s>). |

body.text: tatra khalu bhagavān punareva candraprabhaṃ kumārabhūtamāmantrayate sma - tasmāttarhi kumāra bodhisattvena mahāsattvena anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃboddhukāmena samādhinirdeśakuśalena bhavitavyam | tatra kumāra katamaḥ samādhinirdeśaḥ?yā yathāvattatā sarvadharmāṇāṃ samatā aviṣamatā | akalpanā avikalpanā | aviṭhapanā asamutthāpanā | anutpādaḥ anirodhaḥ | kalpavikalpaparikalpasamucchedaḥ | cittānālambanatā | amanasikāraḥ | prajñaptisamucchedaḥ | vitarkavikalpasamucchedaḥ | rāgadveṣamohasamucchedaḥ | nāntānantamanasikāraḥ | manasikārasamucchedaḥ | skandhadhātvāyatanasvabhāvajñānam | smṛtimatigatihrīdhṛticāritrācāragocarapratipattisthānam | araṇābhūmiḥ | śāntabhūmiḥ | sarvaprapañcasamucchedaḥ | sarvabodhisattvaśikṣā | sarvatathāgatagocaraḥ | sarvaguṇapariniṣpattiḥ | ayamucyate kumāra samādhinirdeśaḥ | yatra samādhinirdeśe pratiṣṭhito bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'virahito bhavati samādhinā, abhrāntacittaśca bhavati, mahākaruṇāsamanvāgato 'prameyāṇāṃ ca sattvānamarthaṃ karoti ||
body.translated_text: There the Blessed One again addressed <s>Candraprabha</s> the prince: "Therefore, O prince, a <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> who wishes to fully awaken to the unsurpassed, perfect awakening should be skilled in the exposition of <s>samādhi</s>. And what, O prince, is the exposition of <s>samādhi</s>? It is the suchness, the equality, the impartiality of all <s>dharmas</s>; non-construction and non-conceptualization; non-distortion and non-arising; non-production and non-cessation; the cutting off of construction, conceptualization, and imagination; the mind without an object; non-attention; the cutting off of designation; the cutting off of discursive and conceptual thought; the cutting off of passion, hatred, and delusion; neither attention to the finite nor the infinite; the cutting off of attention itself; knowledge of the inherent nature of the <s>skandhas</s>, <s>dhātus</s>, and <s>āyatanas</s>; the ground of mindfulness, intellect, comprehension, modesty, firmness, conduct, deportment, domain, and practice; the ground of non-conflict; the ground of peace; the cutting off of all conceptual elaboration; the complete training of all <s>Bodhisattvas</s>; the domain of all <s>Tathāgatas</s>; the full accomplishment of all qualities. This, O prince, is called the exposition of <s>samādhi</s>. A <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> established in this exposition of <s>samādhi</s> is never separated from <s>samādhi</s>, has an unconfused mind, is endowed with great compassion, and accomplishes the welfare of immeasurable beings." ||

body.text: atha khalu bhagavāṃstasyāṃ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata -
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, at that moment, spoke these verses:

children.text: samādhyaviṣamā bhūmiḥ śāntā sūkṣmā sudurdṛśā /
children.translated_text: "The ground of <s>samādhi</s> is impartial, peaceful, subtle, hard to see;

children.text: sarvasaṃjñāsamuddhātaḥ samādhistena cocyate // SRS_13.1 //
children.translated_text: the uprooting of all perceptions — that is called <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.1 //

children.text: akalpaścāvikalpaścāgrāhyatvamanidarśanam /
children.translated_text: "Without construction, without conceptualization, ungraspable, without indication;

children.text: anupalabdhiścittasya samādhistena cocyate // SRS_13.2 //
children.translated_text: the non-apprehension of mind — that is called <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.2 //

children.text: samāhito yadā bhoti sarvadharmā na manyate /
children.translated_text: "When one is concentrated, one does not conceive of any <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: amanyanā yathābhūtaṃ samādhiriti śabditaḥ // SRS_13.3 //
children.translated_text: non-conceiving as it truly is — that is proclaimed as <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.3 //

children.text: na dharme 'sti rajomātra rajaścāpi na vidyate /
children.translated_text: "In <s>dharmas</s> there is not even a particle of dust, and dust itself does not exist;

children.text: anupalabdhirdharmāṇāṃ samādhistena cocyate // SRS_13.4 //
children.translated_text: the non-apprehension of <s>dharmas</s> — that is called <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.4 //

children.text: cittasyānupalabdhiśca vikalpo hyeṣa cocyate /
children.translated_text: "The non-apprehension of mind — even that is called conceptualization;

children.text: avikalpitāśca te dharmā samādhireṣa jānathaḥ // SRS_13.5 //
children.translated_text: those <s>dharmas</s> are non-conceptualized — know that this is <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.5 //

children.text: śabdena sūcito hyarthaḥ sa ca śabdo avastukaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Meaning is indicated by sound, yet that sound is substanceless;

children.text: pratiśrutkopamaḥ śabdo antarīkṣaṃ yathā nabhaḥ // SRS_13.6 //
children.translated_text: sound is like an echo — like the expanse of empty space. // SRS_13.6 //

children.text: asthitā hi ime dharmāḥ sthitireṣāṃ na vidyate /
children.translated_text: "These <s>dharmas</s> are without standing — no standing [place] exists for them;

children.text: asthitiḥ sthitiśabdena svabhāvena na labhyate // SRS_13.7 //
children.translated_text: non-standing is not found through the word 'standing' or by inherent nature. // SRS_13.7 //

children.text: cyavate agatītyevaṃ gatiścāsau na vidyate /
children.translated_text: "It passes away and departs — yet neither passing nor departure exists;

children.text: agatirgatiśabdena samādhirnaditastathā // SRS_13.8 //
children.translated_text: non-departure [expressed] by the word 'departure' — <s>samādhi</s> is proclaimed thus. // SRS_13.8 //

children.text: (Vaidya 80)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 80)

children.text: asamāhito vucyati eṣa manyanā samāhito eṣa dvitīya manyanā /
children.translated_text: "'This one is not concentrated' — that is one kind of conceiving; 'this one is concentrated' — that is a second conceiving;

children.text: amanyamānā vicaranti bodhaye amanyamānā spṛśi bodhimuttamām // SRS_13.9 //
children.translated_text: those who conduct themselves without conceiving proceed toward awakening; without conceiving, they touch the supreme <s>bodhi</s>. // SRS_13.9 //

children.text: samaviṣama eṣa śāntabhūmiḥ śamathavipaśyanānimitta eṣā /
children.translated_text: "This even-uneven ground of peace — this is the mark of <s>śamatha</s> and <s>vipaśyanā</s>;

children.text: seviya imu śānta buddhabodhiṃ sa iha prayukta samādhibhāvanāyām // SRS_13.10 //
children.translated_text: having cultivated this peaceful <s>Buddha</s>-awakening, one is here devoted to the cultivation of <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.10 //

children.text: na ca punariyamakṣarehi śakyaṃ praviśitu arthagati praveśe /
children.translated_text: "And yet this cannot be entered through syllables — the entry into the course of meaning;

children.text: sarvaruta jahitva bhāṣyaghoṣaṃ bhavati samāhita no ca manyanāsya // SRS_13.11 //
children.translated_text: having abandoned all sounds and the noise of speech, one becomes concentrated — yet there is no conceiving for him. // SRS_13.11 //

children.text: yaśca iha samādhi bodhisattvo yatha- upadiṣṭu tathā sthiheta yuktaḥ /
children.translated_text: "And the <s>Bodhisattva</s> who, in this <s>samādhi</s>, as instructed, abides yoked —

children.text: sacediha bhavi kalpadāhu kṣetre girivaramadhyagataṃ na taṃ dahe 'gniḥ // SRS_13.12 //
children.translated_text: even if in that field there were a conflagration lasting a <s>kalpa</s>, fire would not burn him who stands in the midst of a mountain. // SRS_13.12 //

children.text: yatha gaganu na jātu dagdhapūrvaṃ subahukalpaśatehi dahyamānam /
children.translated_text: "Just as space has never been burned, though burned for many hundreds of <s>kalpas</s>,

children.text: gaganasamā adhijānamāna dharmāṃste na jātu dahyati so 'gnimadhye // SRS_13.13 //
children.translated_text: knowing <s>dharmas</s> to be like space, he is never burned even in the midst of fire. // SRS_13.13 //

children.text: saci puna jvalamāna buddhakṣetre praṇidhi karoti samādhiye sthihitvā /
children.translated_text: "And if in a blazing <s>Buddha</s>-field he makes an aspiration, established in this <s>samādhi</s>:

children.text: jvalanu ayu praśāmyatāmaśeṣaṃ pṛthivī vinaśyi na cāsya anyathātvam // SRS_13.14 //
children.translated_text: 'May this fire be completely quenched!' — even if the earth perishes, there is no alteration for him. // SRS_13.14 //

children.text: ṛddhibalu anantu tasya bhoti khagapathi gacchati so asajjamānaḥ /
children.translated_text: "His <s>ṛddhi</s>-power becomes infinite; he goes like a bird-king, unattached;

children.text: imi guṇa anubhoti bodhisattvo yatha-anuśiṣṭu samādhiye sthihitvā // SRS_13.15 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Bodhisattva</s> experiences these qualities, established in the <s>samādhi</s> as instructed. // SRS_13.15 //

children.text: jāyate cyavate vāpi na ca jāti na cyutiḥ /
children.translated_text: "There is birth and there is passing away — yet there is no birth and no passing;

children.text: yasya vijānanā eṣā samādhyasya na durlabhā // SRS_13.16 //
children.translated_text: for one who has this understanding, this <s>samādhi</s> is not hard to obtain. // SRS_13.16 //

children.text: (Vaidya 81)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 81)

children.text: na cyutirnāpi co jāti lokanāthena deśitā /
children.translated_text: "Neither passing away nor birth has been taught by the World-Protector;

children.text: lokanāthaṃ viditvaivaṃ samādhiṃ tena jānatha // SRS_13.17 //
children.translated_text: having understood the World-Protector thus, know the <s>samādhi</s> thereby. // SRS_13.17 //

children.text: anopaliptā lokena lokadharme na sajjati /
children.translated_text: "Untainted by the world, he does not cling to worldly <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: asajjamānaḥ kāyena buddhakṣetrāṇi gacchati // SRS_13.18 //
children.translated_text: unclinging in body, he travels to <s>Buddha</s>-fields. // SRS_13.18 //

children.text: kṣetreṣu paśyate nityaṃ saṃbuddhān lokanāyakān /
children.translated_text: "In those fields he constantly sees the Perfectly Awakened Ones, the World-Leaders;

children.text: dharmaṃ ca śṛṇute tatra buddhakṣetreṣu bhāṣitam // SRS_13.19 //
children.translated_text: and there he hears the <s>Dharma</s> taught in those <s>Buddha</s>-fields. // SRS_13.19 //

children.text: na jātu tasya ajñānaṃ dharmadhātuṃ ca bhāṣate /
children.translated_text: "Ignorance never arises in him; he speaks the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>;

children.text: gatijñaḥ satato dharme dharmadhātumayo hi saḥ // SRS_13.20 //
children.translated_text: he always knows the course of <s>Dharma</s> — for he is of the nature of the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>. // SRS_13.20 //

children.text: bhāṣataḥ kalpakoṭyo 'pi pratibhānaṃ na hīyate /
children.translated_text: "Though he speaks for <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, his eloquence does not diminish;

children.text: nirmiṇoti bahūnanyān bodhisattvān vicakṣaṇaḥ // SRS_13.21 //
children.translated_text: that discerning one creates many other <s>Bodhisattvas</s> [as emanations]. // SRS_13.21 //

children.text: kṣetrātaḥ kṣetra gacchanti bodhisattvāna nirmitāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> created [as emanations] go from field to field,

children.text: sahasrapatrapadmeṣu paryaṅkena niṣaṇṇakāḥ // SRS_13.22 //
children.translated_text: seated cross-legged upon thousand-petaled lotuses. // SRS_13.22 //

children.text: buddhabodhiṃ prakāśenti dhāraṇīsūtraśobhanam /
children.translated_text: they illuminate <s>Buddha-bodhi</s>, the splendid <s>dhāraṇī-sūtra</s>;

children.text: anyāśca sūtrakoṭīyo samādhiṃ śānta bhāvayan // SRS_13.23 //
children.translated_text: and also other <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>sūtras</s>, cultivating the peaceful <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.23 //

children.text: avivartikapathe sthāpenti bahūn sattvānacintiyān /
children.translated_text: 'They establish many inconceivable beings on the irreversible path;

children.text: pratibhānaṃ kṣayaṃ naiti buddhabodhiṃ prakāśiya // SRS_13.24 //
children.translated_text: their eloquence knows no exhaustion, illuminating <s>Buddha-bodhi</s>. // SRS_13.24 //

children.text: kūṭāgāre hi gacchanti ratanehi vicitrite /
children.translated_text: 'They enter mansions adorned with jewels,

children.text: okiranti ca puṣpehi gandhavadbhirvināyakam // SRS_13.25 //
children.translated_text: and shower the Guide with fragrant flowers. // SRS_13.25 //

children.text: okiranti ca cūrṇehi gandhavantehi nāyakam /
children.translated_text: 'They shower the Leader with fragrant powders,

children.text: kurvanti vipulāṃ pūjāṃ sarve te bodhikāraṇāt // SRS_13.26 //
children.translated_text: and all of them perform vast worship for the sake of awakening. // SRS_13.26 //

children.text: aprameyā guṇā ete bodhisattvāna tāyinām /
children.translated_text: 'Immeasurable are these virtues of the <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, the protectors;

children.text: niṣkileśā yadā bhonti tadā ṛddhiṃ labhanti te // SRS_13.27 //
children.translated_text: when they become free from afflictions, then they obtain spiritual powers. // SRS_13.27 //

children.text: anupattikileśāna acchāḥ śuddhāḥ prabhāsvarāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'For those in whom afflictions have not arisen — clear, pure, radiant,

children.text: asaṃskṛtā akopyāśca bodhisattvāna gocarāḥ // SRS_13.28 //
children.translated_text: unconditioned, and unshakable are the domains of the <s>Bodhisattvas</s>. // SRS_13.28 //

children.text: praśāntā upaśāntāśca niṣkileśā anaṅganāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Tranquil, calmed, free from afflictions, without blemish,

children.text: aprapañcā niṣprapañcāḥ prapañcasamatikramāḥ // SRS_13.29 //
children.translated_text: without proliferation, free from conceptual proliferation, transcending all proliferation. // SRS_13.29 //

children.text: apracāro 'kṣarāṇāṃ ca sarvadharmāṇa lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: 'Non-operation of syllables — this is the characteristic of all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: durvijñeyaśca ghoṣeṇa samādhistena cocyate // SRS_13.30 //
children.translated_text: hard to understand by sound — this is called the <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_13.30 //

children.text: akṣayā upaśāntā ca anābhogā adarśanā /
children.translated_text: 'Inexhaustible, calmed, without purposeful effort, without [object of] vision,

children.text: gocaraḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ bhūtakoṭiranāvilā // SRS_13.31 //
children.translated_text: the domain of all <s>Buddhas</s>, the undefiled limit of reality. // SRS_13.31 //

children.text: (Vaidya 82)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 82)

children.text: sarvabuddhāniyaṃ śikṣā sarvadharmasvabhāvatā /
children.translated_text: 'This is the training of all <s>Buddhas</s> — the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: iha śikṣitva saṃbuddhā guṇānāṃ pāramiṃ gatāḥ // SRS_13.32 //
children.translated_text: having trained here, the Perfectly Awakened Ones have gone to the perfection of qualities. // SRS_13.32 //

children.text: na saṃpāraṃ na vāpāraṃ pūrvānto na vikalpitaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Neither this shore nor the other shore — the past limit is not conceptualized;

children.text: tena te sarva saṃbuddhā guṇānāṃ pāramiṃ gatāḥ // SRS_13.33 //
children.translated_text: thereby all those Perfectly Awakened Ones have gone to the perfection of qualities. // SRS_13.33 //

children.text: anāgatānagatikān dharmān jñātvā svabhāvataḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Having known <s>dharmas</s> that have not come and have no destination by their own nature,

children.text: niṣprapañcānanābhogāṃstatra te pāramiṃ gatāḥ // SRS_13.34 //
children.translated_text: free from proliferation, without purposeful effort — there they have gone to perfection.' // SRS_13.34 //

body.text: iti śrīsamādhirāje samādhinirdeśaparivartastrayodaśaḥ || 13 ||
body.translated_text: Thus ends the thirteenth chapter in the noble <s>Samādhirāja</s>, the chapter called 'Instruction on <s>Samādhi</s>' (<s>Samādhinirdeśaparivarta</s>). || 13 ||

body.text:
(Vaidya 83)
14 Smitasaṃdarśanaparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: (Vaidya 83) Chapter 14: The <s>Smitasaṃdarśanaparivarta</s> (Chapter on the Display of the Smile).

body.text: atha khalu candraprabhaḥ kumārabhūta utthāyāsanādekāṃsamuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantametadavocat - āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvat subhāṣiteyaṃ bhagavatā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena sarvadharmasvabhāvasamatā sarvabodhisattvaśikṣāsamādhinirdeśaḥ | yathāpi nāma bhagavan dīrgharātramatra śikṣitvā samudāgato 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau | pratibhāti ca me bhagavan, pratibhāti ca me sugata | bhagavānāha - pratibhātu te kumāra yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase | atha khalu candraprabhaḥ kumārabhūto bhagavatā kṛtāvakāśo bhagavantaṃ saṃmukhaṃ sārūpyābhirgāthābhirabhyaṣṭāvīt -
body.translated_text: Then <s>Candraprabha</s>, the prince, rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, raised his joined palms toward the Blessed One, and said this to the Blessed One: 'It is wonderful, Blessed One, how well this has been spoken by the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One — this instruction on the <s>samādhi</s> of the equality of the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s>, the training of all <s>Bodhisattvas</s>! Just as the Blessed One, having trained in this for a long time, fully attained unsurpassed, perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>! And I am inspired, Blessed One! I am inspired, <s>Sugata</s>!' The Blessed One said: 'Be inspired, O Prince, for this is now the time you deem [appropriate].' Then <s>Candraprabha</s>, the prince, having been given the opportunity by the Blessed One, praised the Blessed One face to face with fitting verses:

children.text: dṛṣṭvāna sattvān dukhitānupadrutān rāgeṇa doṣeṇa sadābhibhūtān /
children.translated_text: 'Having seen beings suffering and afflicted, always overcome by passion and hatred,

children.text: cittaṃ tvayotpāditu bodhikāraṇādū buddho bhaveyaṃ ti prajāna mocakāḥ // SRS_14.1 //
children.translated_text: you generated the mind for the sake of awakening: "May I become a <s>Buddha</s>, a liberator of beings!" // SRS_14.1 //

children.text: cīrṇo 'si vīrye bahukalpakoṭiyo dāne dame saṃyami nityu śikṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'You have practiced vigor for many <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>kalpas</s>; in giving, self-control, and restraint you are always trained;

children.text: śīle ca kṣāntau tatha vīrye 'tandrito dānaṃ ca dattaṃ vipulamanantakam // SRS_14.2 //
children.translated_text: in moral conduct, patience, and also untiring vigor — vast, infinite giving has been given [by you]. // SRS_14.2 //

children.text: na co tava mānasu jātu khinnaṃ hastāṃśca pādāṃstyajamānu jīvitam /
children.translated_text: 'And your mind was never wearied — giving up hands, feet, and life;

children.text: hiraṇyasuvarṇaṃ tatha putradāraṃ rājthaṃ ca tyaktamanapekṣa bhūtvā // SRS_14.3 //
children.translated_text: gold and silver, likewise sons and wife, kingdom too was renounced, having become indifferent. // SRS_14.3 //

children.text: śīlaṃ tavācchaṃ vimalaṃ viśuddham ātmā ca tyakto na ca śīla khaṇḍitam /
children.translated_text: 'Your moral conduct is clear, stainless, and pure; the self was given up, yet conduct was not broken;

children.text: kāyena vācā manasā susaṃvṛtā sudāntacittā sugatā namo 'stu te // SRS_14.4 //
children.translated_text: well-restrained in body, speech, and mind, of well-tamed mind — homage to you, O <s>Sugata</s>! // SRS_14.4 //

children.text: kṣāntīratāḥ kṣāntipathe pratiṣṭhitāḥ kāye kṛte khaṇḍa pi naiva krudhyase /
children.translated_text: 'Delighting in patience, established on the path of patience — even when your body is cut to pieces, you feel no anger;

children.text: kṣīraṃ tataḥ prasravi maitrabhāvanā āścaryabhūtā sugatā namo 'stu te // SRS_14.5 //
children.translated_text: from that flows milk [of] the cultivation of loving-kindness — a wonder! Homage to you, O <s>Sugata</s>! // SRS_14.5 //

children.text: (Vaidya 84)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 84)

children.text: balairupetā daśabhirbalaiḥ sthitā asaṅgujñānī vidi sarvadharmān /
children.translated_text: 'Endowed with the ten powers, established in those powers, of unattached knowledge, you have known all <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: karuṇāni lokahitakara dharmasvāmin anukampase prajā ima arthakāmaḥ // SRS_14.6 //
children.translated_text: compassionate, O worker for the world's welfare, O Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, you have compassion on these beings, desiring their benefit! // SRS_14.6 //

children.text: śūnyaṃ ti jñānaṃ na ca punihāsti sattvo lokaṃ ca dṛṣṭva tathā ti pranaṣṭamārgam /
children.translated_text: '"Empty" is your knowledge, yet here there is no being; and seeing the world on a path that has perished,

children.text: vibodhitāste prakṛtinirātmadharme vimuktijātā na ca kvaci sā vimuktiḥ // SRS_14.7 //
children.translated_text: they are awakened by you to <s>dharmas</s> that are by nature selfless — liberation arises, yet there is no liberation anywhere! // SRS_14.7 //

children.text: pratyādiśaṃ jahiya sadā pramattaṃ jitvā ca māraṃ sabalamanantasainyam /
children.translated_text: 'Having overcome procrastination and always abandoning heedlessness, having conquered <s>Māra</s> with his forces and infinite army,

children.text: buddhitva bodhi vipulāmanantajñānaṃ diśehi dharmaṃ parama viśuddhaśāntam // SRS_14.8 //
children.translated_text: having awakened to the vast, infinite-knowledge <s>bodhi</s> — teach the <s>dharma</s>, supremely pure and peaceful! // SRS_14.8 //

children.text: gaganaṃ pateyyā saha śaśitārakehi pṛthivī vinaśyet sanagaraśailasaṃsthā /
children.translated_text: 'The sky might fall together with the moon and stars; the earth might perish with its cities and mountains;

children.text: ākāśadhāturapi ca siyānyathātvaṃ no caiva tubhyaṃ vitatha bhaṇeyya vācā // SRS_14.9 //
children.translated_text: the space-element too might become otherwise — yet never would you speak a false word! // SRS_14.9 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ duḥkhitān sattvānupalambharatāḥ prajāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Having seen suffering beings, beings who delight in non-apprehension,

children.text: anopalambhaṃ deśesi gambhīrāṃ śāntaśūnyatām // SRS_14.10 //
children.translated_text: you teach non-apprehension — the profound, peaceful emptiness. // SRS_14.10 //

children.text: śikṣito 'si mahāvīra kalpakoṭīracintiyā /
children.translated_text: 'You have been trained, O Great Hero, for inconceivable <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>kalpas</s>,

children.text: anopalambhaśikṣāyāṃ skhalitaṃ te na vidyate // SRS_14.11 //
children.translated_text: in the training of non-apprehension — no stumbling is found in you! // SRS_14.11 //

children.text: yādṛśe śikṣito dharme tādṛśaṃ dharmu bhāṣase /
children.translated_text: 'The <s>dharma</s> in which you were trained — such is the <s>dharma</s> you teach;

children.text: abhūmiratra bālānāṃ yāvanta anyatīrthikāḥ // SRS_14.12 //
children.translated_text: this is beyond the reach of fools — including all the other sectarians. // SRS_14.12 //

children.text: ye sthitā ātmasaṃjñāyāṃ te skhalanti avidvasu /
children.translated_text: 'Those who stand in the perception of self — they stumble in ignorance;

children.text: jñātvā dharmāṇa nairātmyaṃ skhalitaṃ te na vidyate // SRS_14.13 //
children.translated_text: having known the selflessness of <s>dharmas</s>, no stumbling is found in you! // SRS_14.13 //

children.text: bhūtavādī mahāvīra bhūtadharmapratiṣṭhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Speaker of truth, O Great Hero, established in the <s>dharma</s> of truth,

children.text: bhūte satye sthito nātha bhūtāṃ vācaṃ prabhāṣase // SRS_14.14 //
children.translated_text: standing in true reality, O Protector, you speak true words! // SRS_14.14 //

children.text: bhūtā te cārikā āsīd yathā te praṇidhiḥ kṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'True was your conduct, just as your vow was made;

children.text: tasya bhūtasya niṣyandā bhūtāṃ vācaṃ prabhāṣase // SRS_14.15 //
children.translated_text: as the outflow of that truth, you speak true words! // SRS_14.15 //

children.text: bhūtacaryāsu saṃpanno bhūtakoṭīsuśikṣitā /
children.translated_text: 'Accomplished in true conduct, well-trained in the limit of reality,

children.text: bhūtāśayā bhūtacarī bhūtaprajña namo 'stu te // SRS_14.16 //
children.translated_text: of true intention, practicing truth, O truthful wisdom — homage to you! // SRS_14.16 //

children.text: (Vaidya 85)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 85)

children.text: samaste prajñayā nāsti jñānavādi prabhākara /
children.translated_text: 'Equal in wisdom — there is none [equal], O speaker of knowledge, O radiant one;

children.text: jñāne viśeṣatāṃ prāpta jñānavādi namo 'stu te // SRS_14.17 //
children.translated_text: having attained distinction in knowledge, O speaker of knowledge — homage to you! // SRS_14.17 //

children.text: mitrastvaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ maitrī tava subhāvitā /
children.translated_text: 'You are the friend of all beings; your loving-kindness is well-cultivated;

children.text: aprakampyo yathā meruracalaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ // SRS_14.18 //
children.translated_text: unshakable like <s>Meru</s>, immovable, firmly established! // SRS_14.18 //

children.text: gaṇe suvipule śāsturgaṇān saṃparikarṣasi /
children.translated_text: 'O Teacher, in the vast assembly you guide the assemblies;

children.text: gabhīraprajñā sugatā nadase pariṣadgatā // SRS_14.19 //
children.translated_text: of profound wisdom, O <s>Sugata</s>, you roar in the midst of the assembly! // SRS_14.19 //

children.text: siṃhanādaṃ nadi buddhaḥ siṃhavikrāntavikramaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'The <s>Buddha</s> roars the lion's roar, with the stride and valor of a lion;

children.text: jitāste tīrthikāḥ sarve siṃhena kroṣṭukā yathā // SRS_14.20 //
children.translated_text: all the <s>tīrthikas</s> are conquered — as jackals [are conquered] by a lion! // SRS_14.20 //

children.text: adāntadamako vīra adāntā damitāstvayā /
children.translated_text: 'O Hero, tamer of the untamed, the untamed have been tamed by you;

children.text: te ca mitrā dṛḍhā bhonti abhedyā bhonti susthitāḥ // SRS_14.21 //
children.translated_text: and they become firm friends, unbreakable, well-established! // SRS_14.21 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ duḥkhitān sattvānātmadṛṣṭisamāśritān /
children.translated_text: 'Having seen suffering beings clinging to the view of self,

children.text: nairātmya dharmaṃ deśemi yatra nāsti priyāpriyam // SRS_14.22 //
children.translated_text: you teach the <s>dharma</s> of selflessness, wherein there is no liked or disliked. // SRS_14.22 //

children.text: aśikṣitānāṃ bālānāṃ kumārgapathacāriṇām /
children.translated_text: 'For the untrained fools who walk on the wrong path,

children.text: mārgaṃ tvaṃ saṃprakāśesi yena gacchanti nāyakāḥ // SRS_14.23 //
children.translated_text: you illuminate the path by which the Leaders go! // SRS_14.23 //

children.text: ye sthitā ātmasaṃjñāyāṃ duḥkhe te supratiṣṭhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Those who stand in the perception of self — they are firmly established in suffering;

children.text: na te jānanti nairātmyaṃ yatra duḥkhaṃ na vidyate // SRS_14.24 //
children.translated_text: they do not know selflessness, wherein suffering does not exist. // SRS_14.24 //

children.text: akhilitapadadharmadeśako 'si skhalitu na labhyati lokanātha /
children.translated_text: 'You teach the <s>dharma</s> with inexhaustible words; no stumbling is found, O Lord of the World;

children.text: avitatha gira saṃprabhāṣase tvaṃ duḥkhamokṣakarā namaste nātha // SRS_14.25 //
children.translated_text: you speak truthful words — O deliverer from suffering, homage to you, O Protector! // SRS_14.25 //

children.text: bahuniyutaśatā sahasrakoṭyo gaganasthitāḥ pṛthu devanāgayakṣāḥ /
