children.translated_text: of determined meaning, confident, free from the stench of worldliness, always living the holy life. // SRS_17.36 //

children.text: acchedyavākyāḥ pratibhānavanto niruktinirdeśapadārthakovidāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Of irrefutable speech, eloquent, skilled in exposition, etymology, and the meaning of words,

children.text: sarvatrasaṃdarśaka buddhaputrāḥ parigṛhītāḥ kuśalena karmaṇā // SRS_17.37 //
children.translated_text: sons of the <s>Buddha</s> who appear everywhere, sustained by wholesome <s>karma</s>. // SRS_17.37 //

children.text: anantakalpāścariyāya udgatāḥ stutāḥ praśastāḥ sada nāyakehi /
children.translated_text: "Emerged for conduct through incalculable <s>kalpas</s>, always praised and lauded by the Leaders,

children.text: vimokṣatattvārthapadāna deśakāḥ asaṃkiliṣṭāḥ suviśuddhaśīlāḥ // SRS_17.38 //
children.translated_text: teachers of the words of liberation's true meaning, undefiled, of perfectly pure morality. // SRS_17.38 //

children.text: anopaliptāḥ padumena vāriṇā vimukta traidhātukato 'pramattāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Untainted — like a lotus by water — liberated from the three realms, vigilant,

children.text: anopaliptāṣṭahi lokadharmairviśuddhakāyāḥ pariśuddhakarmāḥ // SRS_17.39 //
children.translated_text: untainted by the eight worldly <s>dharmas</s>, of pure body and purified action. // SRS_17.39 //

children.text: alpeccha saṃtuṣṭa mahānubhāvā agṛddha te buddhaguṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Of few desires, content, of great majesty, without greed, established in <s>Buddha</s>-qualities,

children.text: sarveṣa sattvāna gatiḥ parāyaṇā na ghoṣamātrapratipattisārāḥ // SRS_17.40 //
children.translated_text: the refuge and final resort of all beings — not mere sound, but those for whom practice is essential. // SRS_17.40 //

children.text: yatra sthitāstaṃ ca pareṣu deśayu sarvehi buddhehi parigṛhītāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Wherever they are established, they teach that [<s>Dharma</s>] to others; sustained by all Buddhas,

children.text: (Vaidya 110)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 110)

children.text: vaiśvāsikāḥ kośadharā jinānāṃ te sarvi traidhātuki trastamānasāḥ // SRS_17.41 //
children.translated_text: trusted, treasurers of the <s>Jinas</s>' [<s>Dharma</s>] — they whose minds are alarmed at all three realms. // SRS_17.41 //

children.text: praśāntacittāḥ sada raṇyagocarā adhiṣṭhitā lokavināyakebhiḥ /
children.translated_text: "Of pacified minds, always dwelling in the forest, empowered by the World-Guides,

children.text: bhāṣanti sutrāntasahasrakoṭiyo yaṃ caiva bhāṣanti ta buddhavarṇitam // SRS_17.42 //
children.translated_text: they speak <s>koṭis</s> of thousands of <s>sūtrāntas</s> — and whatever they speak is praised by the <s>Buddha</s>. // SRS_17.42 //

children.text: vivarjitāḥ sarvapadebhi laukikāḥ śūnyādhimuktāḥ paramārthadeśakāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Having abandoned all worldly words, devoted to emptiness, teachers of the ultimate truth,

children.text: anantavarṇā guṇasāgaropamāḥ bahuśrutāḥ paṇḍita vijñavantaḥ // SRS_17.43 //
children.translated_text: of infinite praise, like oceans of qualities, greatly learned, wise, and discerning. // SRS_17.43 //

children.text: sacet kumāro bahukalpakoṭiya adhiṣṭhihantaḥ pravadeya varṇam /
children.translated_text: "Even if the prince were to praise [them] for many <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, standing empowered,

children.text: sa alpakaṃ tat parikīrtitaṃ bhaved yathā samudrādudabindurekaḥ // SRS_17.44 //
children.translated_text: that [praise] would be but a small portion described — like a single drop of water from the ocean. // SRS_17.44 //

children.text: tasmiṃśca kāle sa narendraghoṣo deśetimaṃ śānta samādhi durdṛśam /
children.translated_text: "And at that time, <s>Narendraghoṣa</s> taught this peaceful, hard-to-see <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: mahātrisāhasriya lokadhātu devehi nāgehi sphuṭo abhūṣi // SRS_17.45 //
children.translated_text: the great trichiliocosm was filled with gods and <s>nāgas</s>. // SRS_17.45 //

children.text: tasyo imaṃ śānta samādhi bhāṣataḥ prakampitā medini ṣaḍvikāram /
children.translated_text: "As he spoke this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>, the earth trembled in six ways;

children.text: devā manuṣyā yatha gaṅgavālikā avivartikāye sthita buddhajñāne // SRS_17.46 //
children.translated_text: gods and humans as numerous as the sands of the Ganges were established in <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge at the stage of non-retrogression. // SRS_17.46 //

children.text: tatrāsi rājā manujāna īśvaraḥ śirībalo nāma mahānubhāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: "There was a king, a lord of men, named <s>Śrībala</s>, of great majesty;

children.text: putrāṇa tasyo śata pañca āsannabhirūpa prāsādika darśanīyāḥ // SRS_17.47 //
children.translated_text: he had five hundred sons — handsome, gracious, and pleasing to behold. // SRS_17.47 //

children.text: aśīti koṭīśata istriyāṇāmantaḥpuraṃ tasya abhūṣi rājñaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Eighty hundred <s>koṭis</s> of women were the inner palace of that king;

children.text: caturdaśo koṭisahasra pūrṇā duhitaro tasya abhūṣi rājñaḥ // SRS_17.48 //
children.translated_text: and fourteen thousand <s>koṭis</s>, full — such were the daughters of that king. // SRS_17.48 //

children.text: sa kārtikāyāṃ tada pūrṇamāsyāmaṣṭāṅgikaṃ poṣadhamādaditvā /
children.translated_text: "On the full-moon day of <s>Kārttika</s>, having taken the eightfold <s>poṣadha</s> observance,

children.text: (Vaidya 111)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 111)

children.text: aśītikoṭīniyutehi sārdhamupāgamallokagurusya antikam // SRS_17.49 //
children.translated_text: together with eighty <s>koṭi-niyutas</s>, he approached the World-Teacher. // SRS_17.49 //

children.text: vanditva pādau dvipadottamasya nyaṣīdi rājā purato jinasya /
children.translated_text: "Having bowed at the feet of the Supreme among Bipeds, the king sat before the <s>Jina</s>;

children.text: adhyāśayaṃ tasya viditva rājño imaṃ samādhiṃ dvipadendra deśayi // SRS_17.50 //
children.translated_text: knowing the king's disposition, the Lord of Bipeds taught him this <s>samādhi</s>. // SRS_17.50 //

children.text: sa pārthivaḥ śratva samādhimetamutsṛjya rājyaṃ yatha kheṭapiṇḍam /
children.translated_text: "That sovereign, having heard this <s>samādhi</s>, abandoned the kingdom like a lump of spit;

children.text: parityajitvā priya jñātibāndhavān sa pravrajī tasya jinasya śāsane // SRS_17.51 //
children.translated_text: having forsaken beloved relatives and kinsmen, he went forth in that <s>Jina</s>'s teaching. // SRS_17.51 //

children.text: putrāṇa pañcāśata pravrajiṃsu antaḥpuraṃ caiva tathaiva dhītaro /
children.translated_text: "Five hundred sons went forth, as did the inner palace and likewise the daughters;

children.text: anye ca tatra putrajñātibāndhavāḥ ṣaṭsaptatirnayuta trayaśca koṭyaḥ // SRS_17.52 //
children.translated_text: and others there — sons, relatives, and kinsmen — six and seventy <s>nayutas</s> and three <s>koṭis</s>. // SRS_17.52 //

children.text: sa pravrajitveha saputradāraṃ sthapetva āhāranirhārabhūmim /
children.translated_text: "Having gone forth together with wife and sons, having transcended the ground of food-gathering and exertion,

children.text: adhiṣṭhitaścaṃkrami aṣṭavarṣaṃ sa caṃkrame vasthitu kāla kārṣīt // SRS_17.53 //
children.translated_text: empowered, he walked in meditation for eight years — he spent his time on the walking-path. // SRS_17.53 //

children.text: sa kālu kṛtvā tada rājakuñjaro samādhicitto susamāhitaḥ sadā /
children.translated_text: "Having thus spent his time, that elephant among kings, always concentrated in <s>samādhi</s>-mind,

children.text: tatraiva so rājakule upanno upapāduko garbhamalairaliptaḥ // SRS_17.54 //
children.translated_text: was reborn right there in that royal family — apparitionally born, untainted by the impurities of the womb. // SRS_17.54 //

children.text: dṛḍhabalo nāma pitāsya bhūṣi mahāmatī nāma janetri āsīt /
children.translated_text: "His father was named <s>Dṛḍhabala</s>, his mother was named <s>Mahāmatī</s>;

children.text: sa jātamātro avacī kumāro kaccinnu so tiṣṭhati lokanāthaḥ // SRS_17.55 //
children.translated_text: the moment he was born, the prince said: 'Does that World-Protector still abide? // SRS_17.55 //

children.text: jānāti me āśayu lokanātho yeno mamā śānta samādhi deśitaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'The World-Protector knows my disposition — he who taught me the peaceful <s>samādhi</s>,

children.text: (Vaidya 112)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 112)

children.text: apratyayā apagatapratyayā ca yo eka nirdeśu bhave gatīnām // SRS_17.56 //
children.translated_text: free from conditions and beyond conditions — the unique exposition of the courses of existence. // SRS_17.56 //

children.text: yā sarvadharmāṇa svabhāvamudrā yaḥ sūtrakoṭīniyutāna āgamaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'That which is the seal of the inherent nature of all <s>dharmas</s>, the source of <s>koṭis</s> and <s>niyutas</s> of <s>sūtras</s>,

children.text: yo bodhisattvāna dhanaṃ nirūttaraṃ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.57 //
children.translated_text: the unsurpassed treasure of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.57 //

children.text: kāyasya śuddhī tatha vāca śuddhī cittasya śuddhistatha dṛṣṭiśuddhiḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Purity of body, likewise purity of speech, purity of mind, likewise purity of views,

children.text: ārambaṇānāṃ samatikramo yaḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.58 //
children.translated_text: that which is the transcendence of all objects — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.58 //

children.text: avipraṇāśaḥ phaladharmadarśanaṃ aṣṭāṅgikā mārgavarasya bhāvanā /
children.translated_text: "'Non-destruction and the seeing of the fruition of <s>dharmas</s>, the cultivation of the excellent eightfold path,

children.text: tathāgataiḥ saṃgamu tīkṣṇaprajñatā satyapraveśaḥ sada dharmajñānam // SRS_17.59 //
children.translated_text: encounter with <s>Tathāgatas</s>, sharpness of wisdom, entry into truth, and constant <s>Dharma</s>-knowledge — // SRS_17.59 //

children.text: skandhaparijñā samatā ca dhātunāmapakarṣaṇaṃ cāyatanāna sarvaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Full comprehension of the <s>skandhas</s>, equality of the <s>dhātus</s>, removal of the <s>āyatanas</s> in every respect,

children.text: anutpāda sākṣātkriyayāvatāraḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.60 //
children.translated_text: entry into the direct realization of non-arising — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.60 //

children.text: pratisaṃvidā śāntyavatārajñānaṃ sarvākṣarāṇāṃ ca prabhedajñānam /
children.translated_text: "'The knowledge of entry into peace through the analytical knowledges, knowledge of the differentiation of all syllables,

children.text: vastuniveśasamatikramo yaḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.61 //
children.translated_text: that which is the transcendence of the establishment of things — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.61 //

children.text: ghoṣaḥ parijñātha prāmodyalābhaḥ prītiśca bhotī sugatāna varṇam /
children.translated_text: "'Comprehension of sound, attainment of joy, gladness, and the praise of the <s>Sugatas</s>,

children.text: āryā gatirmārdavatā ca ujjukā kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.62 //
children.translated_text: the noble course, gentleness, and straightforwardness — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.62 //

children.text: nā jātu kuryādbhukuṭiṃ sa sūrataḥ sākhilya mādhurya smitaṃ mukhaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: "'He never frowns — gentle, with a sweet smiling face;

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca sattvān prathamālapeti kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.63 //
children.translated_text: and seeing beings, he addresses them first — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.63 //

children.text: (Vaidya 113)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 113)

children.text: anālasyatā gauravatā gurūṇāṃ śuśrūṣaṇā vandana premadarśanā /
children.translated_text: "'Diligence, respect for elders, willingness to serve, salutation, loving regard,

children.text: upapatti saṃtuṣṭita śuklatā ca kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.64 //
children.translated_text: [proper] rebirth, contentment, and purity — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.64 //

children.text: ājīvaśuddhistatha raṇyavāso dhūte sthitānusmṛterapramoṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Purity of livelihood, forest-dwelling, standing in ascetic practices, and non-loss of mindfulness,

children.text: skandheṣu kauśalyamathāpi dhātuṣu kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.65 //
children.translated_text: skill in the <s>skandhas</s> and also in the <s>dhātus</s> — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.65 //

children.text: āyatanakauśalyamabhijñajñānaṃ kileśaapakarṣaṇa dāntabhūmi /
children.translated_text: "'Skill in the <s>āyatanas</s>, knowledge of superknowledges, removal of <s>kleśas</s>, the ground of self-mastery,

children.text: pṛthusarvamantrāṇamasāvucchedaḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.66 //
children.translated_text: the non-destruction of all the vast <s>mantras</s> — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.66 //

children.text: samatikramaḥ sarvabhavaggatīnāṃ jātismṛti dharmaniṣkāṅkṣatā ca /
children.translated_text: "'Transcendence of all courses of existence, memory of past lives, freedom from doubt regarding <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: dharme ca cittaṃ śruta eṣaṇā ca kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.67 //
children.translated_text: the mind [set on] <s>Dharma</s>, and the quest for learning — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.67 //

children.text: viśeṣagāmī sada bhāvanārati āpatti kauśalyata niḥsṛtau sthitaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Always progressing to distinction, delighting in meditation, skilled in [avoiding] transgressions, established in escape,

children.text: yatra sthito 'nuśayitāṃ jahāti kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.68 //
children.translated_text: established where latent tendencies are abandoned — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.68 //

children.text: tīkṣṇasya jñānasya varāgamo yato acāliyo śailasamo akampitaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'The source of the advent of sharp knowledge, immovable like a mountain, unshakable,

children.text: avivartitālakṣaṇa dhāraṇīmukhaṃ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.69 //
children.translated_text: the mark of non-retrogression and the gateway of <s>dhāraṇī</s> — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.69 //

children.text: śuklāna dharmāṇa sadā gaveṣaṇā pāpāna dharmāṇa sadā vivarjanā /
children.translated_text: "'Always seeking wholesome <s>dharmas</s>, always avoiding evil <s>dharmas</s>,

children.text: saṃkleśapakṣasya sadā pracāru yo kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.70 //
children.translated_text: that which is the constant activity of the faction of defilement [being overcome] — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.70 //

children.text: sarvāsu śikṣāsu gatiṃgato viduḥ samādhyavasthānagatiṃgataśca /
children.translated_text: "'The wise one has reached mastery in all trainings, reached mastery in the establishment of <s>samādhis</s>;

children.text: (Vaidya 114)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 114)

children.text: sattvāna co āśayu jñātva codako deśeti dharmaṃ varabuddhabodhau // SRS_17.71 //
children.translated_text: knowing the dispositions of beings, as instructor he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> for the excellent <s>Buddha</s>-awakening. // SRS_17.71 //

children.text: viśeṣajñānaṃ upapattijñānaṃ anantajñānaṃ susamāptajñānam /
children.translated_text: "'Knowledge of distinctions, knowledge of [types of] rebirth, infinite knowledge, perfectly accomplished knowledge,

children.text: sarvaggatīnāṃ pratisaṃdhijñānaṃ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.72 //
children.translated_text: knowledge of the connecting links of all courses — does the <s>Jina</s> still teach that <s>samādhi</s>? // SRS_17.72 //

children.text: gṛhān samutsṛjya pravrajyacittaṃ traidhātuke anabhiratī nanugrahaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Abandoning the household, with mind [set on] going forth, disenchantment with the three realms and compassionate concern,

children.text: cittasya saṃpragrahaṇaṃ saharṣaṇā deśeti dharmaṃ dvipadānamuttamaḥ // SRS_17.73 //
children.translated_text: the restraining and gladdening of the mind — the Supreme among Bipeds teaches this <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.73 //

children.text: dharmeṣu co nābhiniveśa tāyi parigraho dharmavare sadā ca /
children.translated_text: "'Non-attachment to <s>dharmas</s> by the Protector, yet always embracing the excellent <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: karmavipāke ca dṛḍhādhimuktiṃ deśeti dharma dvipadānamuttamaḥ // SRS_17.74 //
children.translated_text: and firm conviction in the ripening of <s>karma</s> — the Supreme among Bipeds teaches this <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.74 //

children.text: vinayasmi kauśalya vipākajñānaṃ kalahaṃ vivādāna tathopaśāntiḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Skill in the <s>Vinaya</s>, knowledge of ripening, the pacification of quarrels and disputes,

children.text: avigrahaṃ vāpyavivādabhūmiṃ deśeti dharma dvipadānamuttamaḥ // SRS_17.75 //
children.translated_text: the ground of non-conflict and non-disputation — the Supreme among Bipeds teaches this <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.75 //

children.text: kṣāntīsamādānamakrodhasthānaṃ viniścaye dharmi sadā ca kauśalam /
children.translated_text: "'Undertaking patience, the ground of non-anger, and constant skill in determining <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: padaprabhedeṣu ca jñānadarśanaṃ deśeti dharmaṃ karuṇāṃ janetvā // SRS_17.76 //
children.translated_text: knowledge and insight into the differentiation of words — having generated compassion, he teaches the <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.76 //

children.text: pūrvāntajñānamaparāntajñānaṃ triyadhvasamatā sugatāna śāsane /
children.translated_text: "'Knowledge of the past, knowledge of the future, equality of the three times in the <s>Sugatas</s>' teaching,

children.text: pariccheda uktaḥ sa trimaṇḍalasya evaṃ jino deśayi dharmasvāmī // SRS_17.77 //
children.translated_text: the threefold circle declared as the distinction — thus the <s>Jina</s>, the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, taught. // SRS_17.77 //

children.text: cittavyavasthāna ekāgratā ca kāyavyavasthāna yathāryabhūmiḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Stability of mind and one-pointedness, stability of body as on the noble ground,

children.text: īryāpathastho sada kāli rakṣaṇā deśeti dharmaṃ puruṣarṣabho muniḥ // SRS_17.78 //
children.translated_text: standing in deportment, always guarding the [proper] time — the Bull among Men, the Sage, teaches this <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.78 //

children.text: (Vaidya 115)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 115)

children.text: hiriśca otrāpyu prāsādikaṃ ca yuktāṃ giraṃ bhāṣati lokajñānam /
children.translated_text: "'Shame and moral dread, graciousness, speaking appropriate speech — knowledge of the world,

children.text: pravṛttidharmaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca prāṇināṃ deśeti dharmaṃ varabodhiumagryām // SRS_17.79 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Dharma</s> of [proper] conduct and the nature of living beings — he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> for the excellent supreme awakening. // SRS_17.79 //

children.text: anugrahaṃ co hirimotrāpyaṃ ca cittasya cākuśalatā jugupsanā /
children.translated_text: "'Compassionate concern, shame and moral dread, disgust at the unskilfulness of mind,

children.text: dhūtasyānutsargata piṇḍacaryāṃ deśeti dharmaṃ dvipadānamuttamaḥ // SRS_17.80 //
children.translated_text: non-abandonment of ascetic practices, and alms-round — the Supreme among Bipeds teaches this <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.80 //

children.text: hiriśca otrāpyu sadācaretā gurūṇābhivādana pratyutthānam /
children.translated_text: "'Shame and moral dread, always practicing [virtue], saluting and rising to greet one's elders,

children.text: mānasya co nigraha āditaiva evaṃ jino deśayi dharmasvāmī // SRS_17.81 //
children.translated_text: and the restraint of pride from the very beginning — thus the <s>Jina</s>, the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, taught. // SRS_17.81 //

children.text: cittasamutthānata cittakalyatā jñānapratīvedhu tathānubodham /
children.translated_text: "'The arising of the mind, the wholesomeness of mind, penetrating knowledge and understanding,

children.text: ajñānapakṣasya sadā vivarjanā deśeti dharmān varabuddhabodhim // SRS_17.82 //
children.translated_text: and always avoiding the faction of ignorance — he teaches <s>dharmas</s> for the excellent <s>Buddha</s>-awakening. // SRS_17.82 //

children.text: cittapraveśaṃ ca rūtasya jñānaṃ niruktyavasthāna viniścitārtham /
children.translated_text: "'Entry into the mind, knowledge of sounds, establishment in etymology, and determined meaning,

children.text: sarveṣvanarthāna sadā vivarjanam evaṃ jino deśayi dharmasvāmī // SRS_17.83 //
children.translated_text: always avoiding all that is harmful — thus the <s>Jina</s>, the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, taught. // SRS_17.83 //

children.text: sasaṅgatā satpuruṣehi nityaṃ vivarjanā kāpuruṣāna caiva /
children.translated_text: "'Constant association with good people, and avoidance of base men,

children.text: jine prasādaṃ sada prematāṃ ca evaṃ jino deśayi dharma śreṣṭham // SRS_17.84 //
children.translated_text: always having faith and love toward the <s>Jinas</s> — thus the <s>Jina</s> taught the supreme <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.84 //

children.text: saṃketaprajñaptivyāhāratāṃ ca saṃsāraduḥkhāni sadā vivarjanā /
children.translated_text: "'Conventional designation and verbal expression, always avoiding the sufferings of <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: alābhi lābhe ca asaktabhāvamevaṃ jino deśayi dharmamuttamam // SRS_17.85 //
children.translated_text: non-attachment regarding gain and non-gain — thus the <s>Jina</s> taught the supreme <s>Dharma</s>. // SRS_17.85 //

children.text: satkāru labdhvā ca na vismayeyyā asatkṛtaścāpi bhavedupekṣakaḥ /
children.translated_text: "'Having received honor, one should not become conceited; and when dishonored, one should remain equanimous;

children.text: bhūte 'pi varṇaṃ na kadāci modiye iya deśanā lokahitasya īdṛśī // SRS_17.86 //
children.translated_text: even when praised truly, one should never rejoice — such is the teaching of the Benefactor of the World. // SRS_17.86 //

children.text: (Vaidya 116)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 116)

children.text: ākrośanāṃ paṃsana sarvaśo sahedasaṃstavaḥ sarvagṛhīhi sārdham /
children.translated_text: "'One should endure all abuse and reviling; one should not associate on familiar terms with all householders;

children.text: saṃsargatāṃ pravrajitena kuryādevaṃ jino deśayi dharmasvāmī // SRS_17.87 //
children.translated_text: one should keep company with the renunciant — thus the <s>Jina</s>, the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, taught. // SRS_17.87 //

children.text: buddhāna co gocari supratiṣṭhito agocaraṃ sarva vivarjayitvā /
children.translated_text: "'Well-established in the domain of the Buddhas, having abandoned all that is not their domain,

children.text: ācārasaṃpanna sudāntacitto iya dharmanetrī sugatena deśitā // SRS_17.88 //
children.translated_text: endowed with [proper] conduct, of well-tamed mind — this eye of <s>Dharma</s> was taught by the <s>Sugata</s>. // SRS_17.88 //

children.text: ye bāladharmāḥ sada tān vivarjayet kuladūṣaṇaṃ sarva vivarjayecca /
children.translated_text: "'One should always avoid the qualities of fools and should avoid all that corrupts families;

children.text: ārakṣitavyaṃ sada buddhaśāsanaṃ evaṃ jino deśayi dharmasvāmī // SRS_17.89 //
children.translated_text: one should always guard the <s>Buddha</s>'s teaching — thus the <s>Jina</s>, the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>, taught. // SRS_17.89 //

children.text: alpaṃ ca bhāṣye madhuraṃ suyuktaṃ kalyāṇatāṃ mṛduvacanaṃ pareṣām /
children.translated_text: "'One should speak little, sweetly, and aptly — [with] goodness and gentle speech toward others;

children.text: pratyarthikānāṃ sahadharmanigraho iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.90 //
children.translated_text: the defeat of adversaries through <s>Dharma</s> itself — such is the instruction of the <s>Jina</s>. // SRS_17.90 //

children.text: pratikramet kāli na co akāle na viśvaset sarvapṛthagjaneṣu /
children.translated_text: "'One should withdraw at the [proper] time and not at the wrong time; one should not trust all ordinary people;

children.text: duḥkhena spṛṣṭo na bhaveta durmanā iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.91 //
children.translated_text: when touched by suffering, one should not become dejected — such is the instruction of the <s>Jina</s>. // SRS_17.91 //

children.text: daridra dṛṣṭvā sadhanaṃ kareyyā duḥśīla dṛṣṭvā anukampitavyā /
children.translated_text: "'Seeing the poor, one should make them wealthy; seeing the immoral, one should have compassion; /

children.text: hitavastutāyāṃ sada ovadeyya iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.92 //
children.translated_text: one should always admonish with beneficial things — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.92 //

children.text: dharmeṇa sattvā anugṛhṇitavyā lokāmiṣatyāgu sadā ca kāryo /
children.translated_text: 'Beings should be benefited through the <s>dharma</s>; worldly gains should always be renounced;

children.text: na saṃcayaṃ no nicayaṃ ca kuryādiyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.93 //
children.translated_text: one should make neither accumulation nor hoarding — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.93 //

children.text: śīlapraśaṃsā ca kuśīlakutsanā aśāṭhyatā śīlavatāṃ niṣevaṇam /
children.translated_text: 'Praising moral conduct and censuring immorality; freedom from hypocrisy and devotion to the virtuous;

children.text: sarvasvakātyāgi dhane 'pyaniśrito iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.94 //
children.translated_text: renouncing everything, not relying even on wealth — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.94 //

children.text: (Vaidya 117)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 117)

children.text: adhyāśayeno guruṇā nimantraṇā yathā ca bhāṣe tatha sarva kuryām /
children.translated_text: 'With sincere intention making invitations to the teacher; "As I speak, so should I do all things";

children.text: abhīkṣṇa seveyya ca dharmabhāṇakaṃ iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.95 //
children.translated_text: one should constantly attend upon the <s>dharma</s>-teacher — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.95 //

children.text: sagauravaḥ prītamanāḥ sadā bhavet somyāya dṛṣṭīya sadā sthito bhavet /
children.translated_text: 'One should always be respectful and of joyful mind; one should always stand in a gentle view;

children.text: pūrvāsu caryāsu suniścitaḥ sadā iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.96 //
children.translated_text: always well-determined in former practices — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.96 //

children.text: pūrvaṃgamaḥ kuśalacarīṣu nityamupāyakauśalya nimittavajane /
children.translated_text: 'Being always foremost in wholesome conduct, [having] skill in means, abandoning signs,

children.text: saṃjñāvivarte tatha vastulakṣaṇe iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.97 //
children.translated_text: turning away from perceptions, and [knowing] the characteristics of objects — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.97 //

children.text: sūtrāntanirhārapadeṣu kauśalaṃ satyāna nirdeśapadeṣu niścayaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Skill in the words that produce the <s>sūtrāntas</s>; certainty in the words that expound the truths;

children.text: vimuktijñānasya ca sākṣikāritā iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.98 //
children.translated_text: and direct realization of the knowledge of liberation — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.98 //

children.text: śūnyāśca dharmāḥ sada sevitavyā viśāradāḥ śīlabale pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Empty <s>dharmas</s> should always be cultivated; being fearless, established in the power of moral conduct,

children.text: samādhisthānena samottareyyā iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.99 //
children.translated_text: one should cross over through the state of <s>samādhi</s> — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.99 //

children.text: na jñātralābhaṃ pi kadāci deśayeccittasya cāpī kuhanāṃ na kuryāt /
children.translated_text: 'One should never teach for the sake of gaining kinsmen; nor should one practice deceit of mind;

children.text: dṛṣṭīkṛtāṃ sarva vivarjayecca iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.100 //
children.translated_text: one should avoid all that is produced by [wrong] views — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.100 //

children.text: pratibhānu śreṣṭhaṃ vara dhāraṇīye jñānasya cobhāsu anantapāro /
children.translated_text: 'Supreme eloquence, excellent <s>dhāraṇī</s> (mnemonic retention), and the radiance of knowledge without limit,

children.text: adhiṣṭhānamantra pratibhānayuktiriyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.101 //
children.translated_text: the foundation of mantras and the power of eloquence — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.101 //

children.text: (Vaidya 118)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 118)

children.text: śīlasya dvāramima mārgabhāvanā pratipatti - ovādanayaśca bhadrako /
children.translated_text: 'This is the gateway of moral conduct: cultivation of the path; the practice and the excellent method of admonition;

children.text: anuśāsanī atra caritva śāsanī iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.102 //
children.translated_text: the exhortation herein, having practiced the teaching — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.102 //

children.text: anulomikī kṣānti ya buddhavarṇitā kṣāntisthito doṣa vivarjayeta /
children.translated_text: 'The conforming patience (<s>ānulomikī kṣānti</s>) praised by the <s>Buddha</s> — established in patience, one should avoid faults;

children.text: ajñāna varjeyya sthihitva jñāne iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.103 //
children.translated_text: one should avoid ignorance, being established in knowledge — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.103 //

children.text: jñānapratiṣṭhā tatha yogabhūmī yogeśvarī bodhayi prasthitānām /
children.translated_text: 'Establishment in knowledge, and the ground of <s>yoga</s>; the mastery of <s>yoga</s> for those set out for awakening;

children.text: niṣevaṇā satpuruṣāṇa nityaṃ iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.104 //
children.translated_text: constant devotion to good persons — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.104 //

children.text: ayuktayogīna sadā vivarjanā tathāgatairbhāṣita buddhabhūmi /
children.translated_text: 'Always avoiding those who practice improperly; the <s>Buddha</s>-stage proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgatas</s>;

children.text: anumoditā sarvihi paṇḍitehi iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.105 //
children.translated_text: approved by all the wise — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.105 //

children.text: bālaiḥ pratikṣipta ajñātakehi abhūbhiratra pṛthuśrāvakāṇām /
children.translated_text: 'Rejected by the foolish and unknowing; beyond the reach here of the great <s>Śrāvakas</s>;

children.text: parigṛhītāḥ sada bodhisattvaiḥ iyaṃ jine īdṛśa ānuśāsanī // SRS_17.106 //
children.translated_text: always embraced by <s>Bodhisattvas</s> — this is such an instruction of the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.106 //

children.text: tathāgatehi anubuddhametaṃ devehi co satkṛtu pūjitaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: 'This has been awakened to by the <s>Tathāgatas</s>; honored and worshipped by gods;

children.text: anumoditaṃ brahmasahasrakoṭibhiḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.107 //
children.translated_text: approved by thousands of <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Brahmās</s> — surely the <s>Jina</s> teaches that <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.107 //

children.text: nāgasahasrehi sadā susatkṛtaṃ suparṇayakṣehi ca kinnarehi /
children.translated_text: 'Always well-honored by thousands of <s>Nāgas</s>, by <s>Suparṇas</s> (Garuḍas), <s>Yakṣas</s>, and <s>Kinnaras</s>;

children.text: yā bhāṣitā bodhivarā jinebhiḥ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.108 //
children.translated_text: that supreme <s>bodhi</s> which was spoken by the <s>Jinas</s> — surely the <s>Jina</s> teaches that <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.108 //

children.text: paryāpta yā nityu supaṇḍitehi dhanaṃ ca śriṣṭhaṃ pravaraṃ sulabdham /
children.translated_text: 'That which is sufficient, always [attained] by the truly wise; the supreme, excellent treasure, well-obtained;

children.text: (Vaidya 119)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 119)

children.text: nirāmiṣaṃ jñāna cikitsa uttamā kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.109 //
children.translated_text: the supreme medicine of knowledge, without material [reward] — surely the <s>Jina</s> teaches that <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.109 //

children.text: jñānasya koṣaḥ pratibhānamakṣayaṃ sūtrāntakoṭīna praveśa eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'The treasury of knowledge, the inexhaustible eloquence, the entrance to <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>sūtrāntas</s>;

children.text: parijña traidhātuki bhūtajñānaṃ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.110 //
children.translated_text: the full comprehension of the three realms, the true knowledge — surely the <s>Jina</s> teaches that <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.110 //

children.text: naukā iyaṃ deśita pāragāmināṃ nāvā pi co oghagatāna eṣā /
children.translated_text: 'This boat has been taught for those who go to the far shore; this too is the vessel for those in the flood;

children.text: kīrtiryaśo vardhati varṇamālā yeṣāmayaṃ śānta samādhi deśitaḥ // SRS_17.111 //
children.translated_text: fame and renown and the garland of praise increase for those to whom this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> has been taught! // SRS_17.111 //

children.text: praśaṃsa eṣā ca tathāgatānāṃ stavaśca eṣo puruṣarṣabhāṇām /
children.translated_text: 'This is the praise of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>; this is the hymn of the Bulls among Men;

children.text: stava bodhisattvāna nayaśca akṣayo yehī ayaṃ śānta samādhi deśitaḥ // SRS_17.112 //
children.translated_text: the praise of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and the inexhaustible method — by those to whom this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> has been taught! // SRS_17.112 //

children.text: maitrī iyaṃ doṣaśame prakāśitā upekṣiyaṃ kāruṇikāna bhūmim /
children.translated_text: 'This is the loving-kindness taught for calming hostility; this is the equanimity, the ground of the compassionate;

children.text: āśvāsayanteṣa mahāśayānāṃ yeṣāṃ kṛtenaiṣa samādhi bhāṣitaḥ // SRS_17.113 //
children.translated_text: encouraging those of great intention — for whose sake this <s>samādhi</s> has been spoken! // SRS_17.113 //

children.text: pratipattiyaṃ deśita siṃhanādināmitu buddhajñānasya varasya āgamaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'This is the practice taught for those who roar like lions; this is the approach to the supreme <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge;

children.text: sarveṣa dharmāṇa svabhāvamudrāḥ samādhyayaṃ deśitu nāyakehi // SRS_17.114 //
children.translated_text: the seal of the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s> — this <s>samādhi</s> has been taught by the Leaders! // SRS_17.114 //

children.text: sarvajñajñānasya ca āharitrimā caryā iyaṃ bodhayi prasthitānām /
children.translated_text: 'This is the sustenance of the knowledge of the omniscient; this is the conduct of those set out for awakening;

children.text: vitrāsanaṃ māracamūya cāpi samādhyayaṃ śānta jinena deśitaḥ // SRS_17.115 //
children.translated_text: and the terror of <s>Māra</s>'s army — this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> has been taught by the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.115 //

children.text: vidyā iyaṃ dharmasthitāna tāyināṃ amitramadhye paramā ca rakṣā /
children.translated_text: 'This is the knowledge of the protectors established in the <s>dharma</s>; the supreme protection amidst enemies;

children.text: pratyarthiṃkānāṃ sahadharmanigrahāḥ samādhyayaṃ śānta jinena deśitaḥ // SRS_17.116 //
children.translated_text: the refutation of opponents through the <s>dharma</s> — this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> has been taught by the <s>Jina</s>! // SRS_17.116 //

children.text: (Vaidya 120)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 120)

children.text: pratibhānabhūmī iya saṃprakāśitā balā vimokṣā tatha indriyāṇi /
children.translated_text: 'This ground of eloquence has been illuminated — the powers, liberations, and faculties;

children.text: viśiṣṭa aṣṭādaśa buddhadharmāḥ samādhi śānteṣa niṣevamāṇāḥ // SRS_17.117 //
children.translated_text: the eighteen distinguished <s>Buddha-dharmas</s> — cultivating this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.117 //

children.text: daśāna paryeṣṭi balāna bhūtā pūrvanimittaṃ pi ca buddhajñāne /
children.translated_text: 'The true search for the ten powers, and also the preliminary sign of <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge;

children.text: ye buddhadharmāḥ puruṣottamena prakāśitā lokahitānukampinā // SRS_17.118 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Buddha-dharmas</s> proclaimed by the Supreme Person, the one who has compassion for the world's welfare! // SRS_17.118 //

children.text: buddhāna putrebhirayaṃ pratīhito vimokṣakāmānayu mārgu deśitaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'This has been entrusted to the sons of the <s>Buddhas</s>; this path has been taught for those who desire liberation;

children.text: prītiśca tasmin sugatātmajānāṃ śruṇitvimaṃ śānta samādhi durdṛśam // SRS_17.119 //
children.translated_text: and there is joy therein for the sons of the <s>Sugata</s> — hearing this peaceful, hard-to-see <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.119 //

children.text: yā buddhajñānasya ca pāripūritā yābheṣate paṇḍitu bodhisattvaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'That which is the fulfillment of <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge, which the wise <s>Bodhisattva</s> desires —

children.text: viśuddhacittaśca śucirniraṅgaṇo imaṃ niṣeveta samādhi śāntam // SRS_17.120 //
children.translated_text: with purified mind, clean and without blemish, let him cultivate this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.120 //

children.text: pariśuddha kāyo 'sya yathā jināna vimokṣajñānaṃ ca vimuktidarśanam /
children.translated_text: 'His body becomes purified like that of the <s>Jinas</s>; and liberation-knowledge and the vision of liberation;

children.text: asaṃkiliṣṭaḥ sada rāgabandhanaiḥ imaṃ niṣeveta samādhi bhadrakam // SRS_17.121 //
children.translated_text: always undefiled by the bonds of passion — let him cultivate this excellent <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.121 //

children.text: abhūmi doṣe vigamaśca mohe jñānasya co āgamu muktimicchataḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Beyond the reach of fault, the departure of delusion, the arising of knowledge for one who desires liberation;

children.text: vidyāya utpādu avidyanāśakam imaṃ niṣeveta samādhi śāntam // SRS_17.122 //
children.translated_text: the production of <s>vidyā</s> (wisdom), the destroyer of <s>avidyā</s> (ignorance) — let him cultivate this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.122 //

children.text: vimuktisārāṇiya tṛpti bhāṣitā dhyāyīnayaṃ śānta samādhi deśitaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Satisfaction for those whose essence is liberation has been taught; this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> has been taught for the meditators;

children.text: cakṣuśca buddhānamaninditānāmimaṃ niṣeveta samādhi śāntam // SRS_17.123 //
children.translated_text: and the eye of the blameless <s>Buddhas</s> — let him cultivate this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.123 //

children.text: abhijña eṣā bahukṣetre darśitā ṛddhiśca buddhāna ananta darśitā /
children.translated_text: 'This higher knowledge has been displayed in many <s>Buddha</s>-fields; the infinite spiritual power of <s>Buddhas</s> has been displayed;

children.text: yā dhāraṇī sāpi tato na durlabhā niṣevamāṇasya samādhimetam // SRS_17.124 //
children.translated_text: and <s>dhāraṇī</s> (mnemonic retention) too is not hard to obtain for one who cultivates this <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.124 //

children.text: (Vaidya 121)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 121)

children.text: śāntendriyasyo iha sthānu bodhaye idamadhiṣṭhānamanantadarśitam /
children.translated_text: 'For one of peaceful faculties here, this is the foundation for awakening; this infinitely displayed foundation;

children.text: sūkṣmaṃ ca jñānaṃ vipulaṃ viśuddhaṃ niṣevamāṇasya imaṃ samādhim // SRS_17.125 //
children.translated_text: and subtle, vast, and purified knowledge — for one who cultivates this <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.125 //

children.text: su budhyate naiṣa ayuktayogairvivartanaṃ sarvasu akṣarāṇām /
children.translated_text: 'This is not well understood by those who practice improperly — the turning away from all syllables;

children.text: na śakyu ghoṣeṇa vijānanāya yeno ayaṃ śānta samādhi na śrutaḥ // SRS_17.126 //
children.translated_text: it cannot be known by sound — by one who has not heard this peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.126 //

children.text: jñātaṃ tu vijñairayu bodhisattvairyathā va yaṃ deśitu dharmasvāminā /
children.translated_text: 'But it is known by the wise, those <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, just as it was taught by the Lord of <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: pratibuddhu śāntehi aninditehi imaṃ samādhiṃ pratiṣevamāṇaiḥ // SRS_17.127 //
children.translated_text: awakened to by the peaceful, the blameless ones — by those who cultivate this <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.127 //

children.text: ārabdhavīryehi samudgṛhītamupasthitaṃ ca sāpi sadā sudhāritam /
children.translated_text: 'It has been grasped by those of aroused vigor, well-attended to, and always well-retained;

children.text: duḥkhakṣayo jātinirodhajñānamimaṃ samādhiṃ pratiṣevamāṇaiḥ // SRS_17.128 //
children.translated_text: the exhaustion of suffering, the knowledge of the cessation of birth — by those who cultivate this <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.128 //

children.text: sarveṣa dharmāṇamajāti bhāṣitā evaṃ ca sarvāsu bhavaggatīṣu /
children.translated_text: 'The non-arising of all <s>dharmas</s> has been declared; and thus in all existences and destinies;

children.text: jñānāgru buddhāna mahāśayānāṃ kaccijjino bhāṣati taṃ samādhim // SRS_17.129 //
children.translated_text: the supreme knowledge of the <s>Buddhas</s> of great intention — surely the <s>Jina</s> teaches that <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_17.129 //

children.text: tasyo kumārasyimi gātha bhāṣato aṣṭāśītiniyutasahasra pūrṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'While this prince was speaking these verses, eighty-eight thousand <s>nayutas</s>, complete,

children.text: ghoṣānugā kṣānti labhiṃsu tatra avivartikāye sthitu buddhajñāne // SRS_17.130 //
children.translated_text: following his voice, attained patience there — established in irreversible <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge! // SRS_17.130 //

children.text: dṛḍhabalastamavadī kumāramadyāpi so tiṣṭhati lokanāthaḥ /
children.translated_text: '<s>Dṛḍhabala</s> (Firm Power) said to the prince: "Even now that Lord of the World abides;

children.text: pṛcchāmi tvaṃ dāraka etamarthaṃ kutastvayā eṣa śrutaḥ samādhiḥ // SRS_17.131 //
children.translated_text: I ask you, young prince, about this matter: from where did you hear this <s>samādhi</s>?" // SRS_17.131 //

children.text: kumāru rājan avadī śṛṇohi dṛṣṭasmi koṭīniyutaṃ jinānām /
children.translated_text: 'The prince said: "O King, listen! I have seen a <s>koṭī-nayuta</s> of <s>Jinas</s>;

children.text: (Vaidya 122)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 122)

children.text: ekasmi kalpasmi te sarvi satkṛtā ayaṃ ca me śānta samādhi pṛcchitaḥ // SRS_17.132 //
children.translated_text: in a single <s>kalpa</s> they were all honored by me, and this peaceful <s>samādhi</s> was sought by me. // SRS_17.132 //

children.text: catvāri kalpā navatiṃ ca anye kalpāna koṭīniyutā sahasrāḥ /
children.translated_text: '"Ninety-four <s>kalpas</s>, and thousands of <s>koṭī-nayutas</s> of <s>kalpas</s> —

children.text: jātismaro bhomyahu tatra tatra na cāpi garbhe upapadyi jātu // SRS_17.133 //
children.translated_text: I remember my births, going here and there, and I have never been reborn in a womb. // SRS_17.133 //

children.text: tato mayā eṣā samādhi bhāvitaḥ śuddhaṃ śrutasteṣa jināna bhāṣatām /
children.translated_text: '"Then this <s>samādhi</s> was cultivated by me; I heard the pure [teaching] of those <s>Jinas</s> as they spoke;

children.text: śrutvā ca uddiṣṭu janetva chandaṃ niṣkāṅkṣaāptena spṛśiṣyi bodhim // SRS_17.134 //
children.translated_text: having heard and having it pointed out, generating aspiration — with a doubtless attainment, I shall touch <s>bodhi</s>! // SRS_17.134 //

children.text: ye bhikṣu mahyaṃ paripṛcchadenti paryāpuṇantasya imaṃ samādhim /
children.translated_text: '"Whatever monks question me while I am mastering this <s>samādhi</s> —

children.text: upasthapemī ahu tatra gauravaṃ yathaiva lokārthakarāṇa antike // SRS_17.135 //
children.translated_text: I establish respect there toward them, just as toward those who work for the world's welfare. // SRS_17.135 //

children.text: yeṣāṃ mayā antika eka gāthā uddiṣṭa caryāṃ caratānulomikīm /
children.translated_text: '"Those from whose presence a single verse was taught to me while practicing conforming conduct —

children.text: mānyāmi tānapyahu śāntu ete upasthapemī ahu buddhagauravam // SRS_17.136 //
children.translated_text: I honor them too; they are peaceful — I establish the respect [due to] a <s>Buddha</s> [toward them]. // SRS_17.136 //

children.text: yaścāpi māṃ pṛcchitu kaścideti paryāpuṇantaṃ imu satsamādhim /
children.translated_text: '"And whoever comes to question me while I am mastering this excellent <s>samādhi</s> —

children.text: svapnāntare 'pīha na me 'sti kāṅkṣā nāhaṃ bhaviṣye jinu lokanāyakaḥ // SRS_17.137 //
children.translated_text: even in a dream there is no doubt for me [that]: 'I shall become a <s>Jina</s>, a Lord of the World!' // SRS_17.137 //

children.text: vṛddheṣu madhyeṣu naveṣu bhikṣuṣu sagauravo bhomyahu supratītaḥ /
children.translated_text: '"Among elder, middle, and junior monks, I am always respectful and well-contented;

children.text: sagāravasyo mama vardhate yaśaḥ puṇyaṃ ca kīrtiśca guṇāstathaiva // SRS_17.138 //
children.translated_text: through my respectfulness, my fame increases, and merit, and renown, and virtues likewise. // SRS_17.138 //

children.text: kalīvivādeṣu na bhomi utsuko alpotsuko bhomyahu tatra kāle /
children.translated_text: '"I am not eager for quarrels and disputes; I have little eagerness at that time;

children.text: anyā gatirbhoti karitva pāpakaṃ anyā gatirbhoti karitva bhadrakam // SRS_17.139 //
children.translated_text: [I know:] different is the destiny of one who does evil, different is the destiny of one who does good. // SRS_17.139 //

children.text: ayuktayogāna asaṃyatānāmamanojña teṣāṃ vacanaṃ śruṇitvā /
children.translated_text: '"Having heard the unpleasant words of those who practice improperly, who are unrestrained —

children.text: (Vaidya 123)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 123)

children.text: karmasvako bhomyahu tasmi kāle kṛtasya karmasya na vipraṇāśaḥ // SRS_17.140 //
children.translated_text: I am the owner of my own <s>karma</s> at that time — <s>karma</s> that has been done is never lost! // SRS_17.140 //

children.text: na hyatra krodho bhavatī parāyaṇaṃ kṣāntībalaṃ gṛhṇayahu buddhavarṇitam /
children.translated_text: '"For here anger does not become a refuge; I grasp the power of patience praised by the <s>Buddha</s>;

children.text: kṣāntiḥ sadā varṇita nāyakehi kṣāntiṃ niṣevitva na bodhi durlabhā // SRS_17.141 //
children.translated_text: patience has always been praised by the Leaders — having cultivated patience, <s>bodhi</s> is not hard to obtain! // SRS_17.141 //

children.text: ahaṃ ca bhomī sada śīlavanto anyāṃśca śīlasmi pratiṣṭhapemi /
children.translated_text: '"I am always one of moral conduct, and I establish others in moral conduct;

children.text: śīlasya varṇu sadahaṃ bhaṇāmi varṇaṃ ca bhoti mama tatra bhāṣitam // SRS_17.142 //
children.translated_text: I always describe the praise of moral conduct, and my speaking thereof becomes [itself] praise! // SRS_17.142 //

children.text: araṇyavarṇaṃ ca sadā pi bhāṣe śīlasmi co bhomi sadā pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: '"I always praise forest-dwelling too, and I am always established in moral conduct;

children.text: samādapemi ahu anya poṣadhe tāṃścaiva bodhāya samādapemi // SRS_17.143 //
children.translated_text: I encourage others in the <s>poṣadha</s> (observance days), and I encourage them too toward awakening! // SRS_17.143 //

children.text: tān brahmacarye 'pi samādapemi arthasmi dharmasmi pratiṣṭhapemi /
children.translated_text: '"I encourage them in the holy life too; I establish them in meaning and in <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: teṣāṃ ca bodhimyahu bodhimārgaṃ yasminnime bhonti ananta saṅgāḥ // SRS_17.144 //
children.translated_text: and I show them the path to awakening, the <s>bodhi</s> — wherein these infinite assemblies exist! // SRS_17.144 //

children.text: smarāmyahaṃ kalpamatītamadhvani yadā jino āsi svarāṅgaghoṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: '"I remember in a past <s>kalpa</s>, in a bygone age, when there was a <s>Jina</s> named <s>Svarāṅgaghoṣa</s> (Voice of All Limbs);

children.text: pratijña tasyo purataḥ kṛtā me kṣāntībalo bhomyahu nityakālam // SRS_17.145 //
children.translated_text: a vow was made by me in his presence: 'I shall always be one of the power of patience!' // SRS_17.145 //

children.text: tatra pratijñāya pratiṣṭhihitvā varṣāṇa koṭī caturo aśītim /
children.translated_text: '"Having made that vow and become established therein, for eighty-four <s>koṭīs</s> of years

children.text: māreṇahaṃ kutsita paṃsitaśca na caiva cittaṃ mama jātu kṣubdham // SRS_17.146 //
children.translated_text: I was reviled and harassed by <s>Māra</s> — yet my mind was never disturbed! // SRS_17.146 //

children.text: jijñāsanāṃ tatra karitva māro jñātvāna mahyaṃ dṛḍha kṣāntimaitrīm /
children.translated_text: '"Having tested me there, <s>Māra</s>, knowing my firm patience and loving-kindness,

children.text: prasannacittaścaraṇāni vandya me pañcaśatā bodhivarāya prasthitāḥ // SRS_17.147 //
children.translated_text: with a serene mind, bowing at my feet — five hundred [of his followers] set out for the supreme <s>bodhi</s>! // SRS_17.147 //

children.text: (Vaidya 124)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya 124)

children.text: amatsarī bhomyahu nityakālaṃ tyāgasya co varṇa sadā prabhāṣe /
children.translated_text: '"I am free from envy at all times, and I always proclaim the praise of generosity —'

children.text: āḍhyaśca bhomī dhanavān mahātmā durbhikṣakāle bahu bhomi dāyakaḥ // SRS_17.148 //
children.translated_text: wealthy shall I be on the earth, a rich great-souled one, a generous donor in times of famine! // SRS_17.148 //

children.text: ye bhikṣu dhārenti imaṃ samādhiṃ ye cāpi vācenti ya uddiśanti /
children.translated_text: "Those monks who retain this <s>samādhi</s>, and those who recite it and those who expound it —

children.text: karomi teṣāṃ ahu pāricaryāṃ sarve ca bheṣyanti narāṇamuttamāḥ // SRS_17.149 //
children.translated_text: I shall perform service to them, and all of them shall become the supreme among men! // SRS_17.149 //

children.text: karmaṇā tenāhamanuttareṇa paśyāmi buddhān bahu lokanāthān /
children.translated_text: "By that unsurpassed <s>karma</s>, I behold many <s>Buddhas</s>, Lords of the World;

children.text: labhitva pravrajya jinānuśāsane bhavāmi nityaṃ vidu dharmabhāṇakaḥ // SRS_17.150 //
children.translated_text: having obtained the going forth in the teaching of the <s>Jina</s>, I always become a wise <s>Dharma</s>-preacher! // SRS_17.150 //

children.text: dhūtābhiyukto ahu bhomi nityaṃ kāntāramāraṇya sadā niṣevī /
children.translated_text: "Devoted to the ascetic practices (<s>dhūtas</s>), I am always a dweller in the wilderness and forest;

children.text: nāhārahetoḥ kuhanāṃ karomi saṃtuṣṭu bhomī itaretareṇa // SRS_17.151 //
children.translated_text: I do not engage in deception for the sake of food — I am content with whatever comes! // SRS_17.151 //

children.text: anīrṣuko bhomyahu nityakālaṃ kuleṣu cāhaṃ na bhavāmi niśritaḥ /
children.translated_text: "I am without envy at all times, and I am not dependent upon families;

children.text: kuleṣu saktasya hi īrṣya vardhate anīrṣyukastuṣṭi vaneṣu vindami // SRS_17.152 //
children.translated_text: for one attached to families, envy increases — being without envy, I find contentment in the forests! // SRS_17.152 //

children.text: maitrīvihārī ahu bhomi nityamākruṣṭu santā na janemi krodham /
children.translated_text: "I always abide in loving-kindness — when reviled, I remain calm, I do not generate anger;

children.text: maitrīvihāriṣyami sūratasya caturdiśaṃ vardhati varṇamālā // SRS_17.153 //
children.translated_text: I shall abide in loving-kindness, gentle — in the four directions, the garland of his fame spreads! // SRS_17.153 //

children.text: alpecchu saṃtuṣṭu bhavāmi nityamāraṇyakaścaiva dhutābhiyuktaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Of few desires, content, I am always a forest-dweller, devoted to the ascetic practices;

children.text: na cotsṛjāmī ahu piṇḍapātaṃ dṛḍhaṃ samādhāna dhuteṣu vindami // SRS_17.154 //
children.translated_text: and I do not abandon alms-gathering — I find firm concentration in the ascetic qualities! // SRS_17.154 //

children.text: śrāddhaśca bhomī manasaḥ prasādo bahuprasādaḥ sada buddhaśāsane /
children.translated_text: "Faithful I am, with a serene mind, with great faith always in the <s>Buddha</s>'s teaching;

children.text: (Vaidya 125)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 125)

children.text: prasāda bahu lapsyami ānuśaṃsā prāsādiko bhomi ahīna indriyaḥ // SRS_17.155 //
children.translated_text: many benefits of faith shall I obtain — I become majestic, with undiminished faculties! // SRS_17.155 //

children.text: yaścaiva bhāṣāmyahu tatra tiṣṭhe pratipattisāro ahu nityu bhomi /
children.translated_text: "Whatever I speak, I stand by it — I am always one whose essence is practice;

children.text: pratipattisārasyimi devanāgāḥ kurvantyusthānu prasannacittāḥ // SRS_17.156 //
children.translated_text: for one whose essence is practice, gods and <s>Nāgas</s> rise up with serene minds [to honor him]! // SRS_17.156 //

children.text: guṇā ime kīrtita yāvatā me ete ca anye ca bahū aneke /
children.translated_text: "These qualities have been proclaimed, as many as are mine — these and many others besides,

children.text: ye śikṣitavyāḥ sada paṇḍitena yo icchatī budhyitu buddhabodhim // SRS_17.157 //
children.translated_text: which should always be trained in by the wise one who desires to awaken to the <s>Buddha</s>'s awakening! // SRS_17.157 //

children.text: smarāmyato bahutaru duṣkarāṇi ye pūrvakalpe caritānyaneke /
children.translated_text: "I remember from that [time] many more difficult deeds — many practiced in former <s>kalpas</s>;

children.text: bahuṃ pi dānīṃ bhaṇitu na śakyaṃ gacchāmi tāvat sugatasya antikam // SRS_17.158 //
children.translated_text: much indeed cannot be spoken now — let me go to the presence of the <s>Sugata</s>." // SRS_17.158 //

children.text: sutīkṣṇaprajño vidu bodhisattvo tasmin kṣaṇe sparśayi pañcabhijñā /
children.translated_text: "The <s>Bodhisattva</s>, wise, of exceedingly sharp wisdom, at that instant attained the five superknowledges;

children.text: ṛddhīya so gacchi jinasya antike sa prāṇikoṭībhiraśītibhiḥ saha // SRS_17.159 //
children.translated_text: by supernatural power he went to the presence of the <s>Jina</s>, together with eighty <s>koṭis</s> of living beings. // SRS_17.159 //

children.text: dṛḍhabalo paramu udagra āsīt sārdhaṃ tadā koṭiśatehi ṣaṣṭibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: "<s>Dṛḍhabala</s>, supremely exalted, was there together with sixty hundred <s>koṭis</s>;

children.text: upasaṃkramī mūlu tathāgatasya vanditva pādau purato nyaṣīdat // SRS_17.160 //
children.translated_text: he approached the root of the <s>Tathāgata</s> [tree], bowed at his feet, and sat down before him. // SRS_17.160 //

children.text: adhyāśayaṃ tasya viditva rājño imaṃ samādhiṃ dvipadendra deśayi /
children.translated_text: "Having known the king's inclination, the Lord of Bipeds taught him this <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: śrutvā ca so pārthivimaṃ samādhiṃ ujjhitva rājyaṃ nirapekṣu pravrajī // SRS_17.161 //
children.translated_text: and that king, having heard this <s>samādhi</s>, abandoned his kingdom and went forth without attachment. // SRS_17.161 //

children.text: sa pravrajitvāna imaṃ samādhiṃ bhāveti vāceti prakāśayeti /
children.translated_text: "Having gone forth, he cultivated, recited, and proclaimed this <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: sa ṣaṣṭibhiḥ kalpasahasru paścāt padmottaro nāma jino abhūṣi // SRS_17.162 //
children.translated_text: after sixty thousand <s>kalpas</s>, he became a <s>Jina</s> named <s>Padmottara</s> (Supreme Lotus)! // SRS_17.162 //

children.text: ṣaṣṭistadā koṭiśata anūnakā ye rājña sārdhaṃ upasaṃkramī jinān /
children.translated_text: "No fewer than sixty hundred <s>koṭis</s> who had come with the king to the <s>Jinas</s> —

children.text: (Vaidya 126)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 126)

children.text: te cāpi śrutvaiva samādhimetaṃ tuṣṭā udagrāstada pravrajiṃsu // SRS_17.163 //
children.translated_text: they too, having heard this <s>samādhi</s>, joyful and elated, went forth at that time. // SRS_17.163 //

children.text: te pravrajitvāna imaṃ samādhiṃ dhāreṃsu vāceṃsu prakāśayiṃsu /
children.translated_text: "Having gone forth, they retained, recited, and proclaimed this <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: ṣaṣṭīna kalpāni nayutāna atyayā spṛśiṃṣu bodhiṃ varamekakalpe // SRS_17.164 //
children.translated_text: after the passing of sixty <s>niyutas</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, they all touched awakening in one <s>kalpa</s>! // SRS_17.164 //

children.text: anantajñānottaranāmadheyā abhūṣi buddhā naradevapūjitāḥ /
children.translated_text: "They became <s>Buddhas</s> bearing the name <s>Anantajñānottara</s> (Supreme Infinite Knowledge), honored by gods and men;

children.text: tadekameke dvipadānamuttamo mocenti sattvānyatha gaṅgavālikāḥ // SRS_17.165 //
children.translated_text: each one of those supreme among bipeds liberated beings as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>! // SRS_17.165 //

children.text: śīrībalo rāju ahaṃ abhūṣi imāṃ caranto varabodhicārikām /
children.translated_text: "I was the king named <s>Śīrībala</s>, practicing this supreme conduct of awakening;

children.text: ye mama putrāḥ śata pañca āsan imameva ete anudharmapāpāḥ // SRS_17.166 //
children.translated_text: my sons, who were five hundred, also followed this very <s>Dharma</s>! // SRS_17.166 //

children.text: evaṃ mayā kalpasahasrakoṭayo ārabdhavīryeṇa atandritena /
children.translated_text: "Thus, for <s>koṭis</s> of thousands of <s>kalpas</s>, with energetic effort, untiring,

children.text: samādhi paryeṣṭa ayaṃ viśuddhaḥ samudānayanneti tamagrabodhim // SRS_17.167 //
children.translated_text: this pure <s>samādhi</s> was sought — one who accumulates it goes to the supreme awakening! // SRS_17.167 //

children.text: kumāra tasmāddhi ye bodhisattvā ākāṅkṣate etu samādhimeṣitum /
children.translated_text: "Therefore, prince, those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who aspire to seek this <s>samādhi</s> —

children.text: ārabdhavīryo nirapekṣu jīvite mamā kumārā anuśikṣate sadā // SRS_17.168 //
children.translated_text: with energetic effort, indifferent to life, let them always train following me, princes!" // SRS_17.168 //

body.text: iti śrīsamādhirāje bahubuddhanirhārasamādhimukhaparivarto nāma saptadaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thus ends the seventeenth chapter of the noble <s>Samādhirāja</s>, named "The Chapter on the <s>Samādhi</s>-Gateway Brought Forth by Many <s>Buddhas</s>" (<s>Bahubuddhanirhārasamādhimukhaparivarta</s>). //

body.text:
(Vaidya 127)
18 Samādhyanuparindanaparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 127) Chapter 18: The Chapter on Entrustment of the <s>Samādhi</s> (<s>Samādhyanuparindanaparivarta</s>).

body.text: tatra bhagavāṃścandraprabhakumāramāmantrayate sma - tasmāt tarhi kumāra yo bodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ samādhimudgrahīṣyati paryavāpsyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati pravartayiṣyati uddekṣyati svādhyāsyati parebhyaśca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayiṣyati, tena bhāvanāyogamanuyuktena ca bhavitavyam | tasyaitaṃ pratipadyamānasya catvāro guṇānuśāṃsāḥ pratikāṅkṣitavyāḥ | katame catvāraḥ? yaduta anabhibhūto bhaviṣyati puṇyaiḥ || anavamardanīyo bhaviṣyati pratyarthikaiḥ | aprameyo bhaviṣyati jñānena | anantaśca bhaviṣyati pratibhānena | yo hi kaścit kumāra bodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ samādhimudgrahīṣyati paryavāpsyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati pravartayiṣyati uddekṣyati svādhyāsyati parebhyaśca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayiṣyati, tasyeme catvāro guṇānuśaṃsāḥ pratikāṅkṣitavyāḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thereupon the Blessed One addressed the prince <s>Candraprabha</s>: "Therefore, prince, whatever <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> will take up, master, retain, recite, circulate, expound, study, and extensively proclaim this <s>samādhi</s> to others — he should also be devoted to the practice of cultivation. For one who thus practices, four qualities and benefits are to be expected. Which four? Namely: he will be unconquered by merit; he will be unassailable by adversaries; he will be immeasurable in knowledge; and he will be infinite in eloquence. Whatever <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s>, prince, will take up, master, retain, recite, circulate, expound, study, and extensively proclaim this <s>samādhi</s> to others — these four qualities and benefits are to be expected for him." //

body.text: atha khalu bhagavāṃstasyāṃ velāyāmi gāthā abhāṣata -
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, at that time, spoke these verses —

children.text: anābhibhūtaḥ puṇyehi nityakālaṃ bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: "Unconquered by merits he will be at all times,

children.text: samādhiṃ śāntubhāvena sarvabuddhāna gocaram // SRS_18.1 //
children.translated_text: [retaining] this <s>samādhi</s> of the nature of peace, the domain of all <s>Buddhas</s>! // SRS_18.1 //

children.text: puṇyehi rakṣitaḥ śūro nityakālaṃ bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: "Protected by merits, a hero, he will be at all times,

children.text: caran sa paramāṃ śuddhāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ bodhicārikām // SRS_18.2 //
children.translated_text: practicing the supreme, pure, and eminent conduct of awakening! // SRS_18.2 //

children.text: nāsya pratyarthiko jātu viheṭhāṃ kaścit kariṣyati /
children.translated_text: "Never will any adversary cause him harm;

children.text: parigṛhīto buddhehi nityakālaṃ bhaviṣyati // SRS_18.3 //
children.translated_text: he will be embraced by the <s>Buddhas</s> at all times! // SRS_18.3 //

children.text: aprameyaśca jñānena nityakālaṃ bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: "Immeasurable in knowledge he will be at all times;

children.text: anantaḥ pratibhānena dhārentaḥ śāntimāṃ gatim // SRS_18.4 //
children.translated_text: infinite in eloquence — one who retains the peaceful course! // SRS_18.4 //

children.text: satatamanabhibhūtapuṇyaskandho bhaviṣyati śreṣṭhataraṃ tu bodhicaryām /
children.translated_text: "His aggregate of merit will be always unconquered; the supreme conduct of awakening will be his;

children.text: na bhaviṣyati pratyarthiṃkāna dhṛṣyo imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_18.5 //
children.translated_text: he will not be assailable by adversaries — having retained this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.5 //

children.text: jñānu vipulu tasya bhoti tīkṣṇaṃ tatha pratibhānamananta cakṣu śuddham /
children.translated_text: "His knowledge is vast and sharp, and his eloquence infinite, his eye pure;

children.text: bhaviṣyati sada tasya paṇḍitasya smṛtibalameva ca dhāraṇībalaṃ ca // SRS_18.6 //
children.translated_text: he will always possess mindfulness and the power of <s>dhāraṇī</s> — that wise one! // SRS_18.6 //

children.text: (Vaidya 128)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 128)

children.text: parama priyu manāpu paṇḍitānāṃ bhaviṣyati cārthapadaṃ prabhāṣamāṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: "He will be supremely dear and agreeable to the wise, speaking meaningful words;

children.text: jñānu bahujanasya prajñavanto imu varu śānta samādhi bhāṣamāṇaḥ // SRS_18.7 //
children.translated_text: a wise knower of many beings — while proclaiming this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.7 //

children.text: lābhi parama śreṣṭha cīvarāṇāṃ śayya nimantraṇamā(khā ?)dyabhojanānām /
children.translated_text: "A gainer of the supreme, finest robes, bedding, invitations, food, and drink,

children.text: bhaviṣyati sukumāra darśanīyo imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayanto // SRS_18.8 //
children.translated_text: he will be delicate and beautiful to behold — one who retains this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.8 //

children.text: drakṣyati bahu buddha lokanāthān atuliya kāhiti pūja nāyakānām /
children.translated_text: "He will behold many <s>Buddhas</s>, Lords of the World, and perform incomparable worship to the Guides;

children.text: na ca bhaviṣyati tasya antarāyo imu varu śānta samādhimeṣato hi // SRS_18.9 //
children.translated_text: and no obstacle will arise for him — one who seeks this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.9 //

children.text: bhāṣiṣyati purataḥ sthitva lokanāthān surucira gāthaśatehi tuṣṭacittaḥ /
children.translated_text: "He will stand before the Lords of the World and praise them with hundreds of beautiful verses, with a joyful mind;

children.text: na ca bhaviṣyati tasya jātu hānī imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_18.10 //
children.translated_text: and there will never be loss for him — having retained this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.10 //

children.text: sthāsyati purato 'sya lokanāthaḥ suruciralakṣaṇakāyu vyañjanebhiḥ /
children.translated_text: "The Lord of the World will stand before him, with his supremely beautiful body of marks and minor characteristics;

children.text: na ca bhaviṣyati tasya jñānahānī imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_18.11 //
children.translated_text: and there will be no loss of knowledge for him — having retained this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.11 //

children.text: na kadāci bhaviṣyati dīnacittaḥ satata bhaviṣyati āḍhyu no daridraḥ /
children.translated_text: "Never will he be of dejected mind; he will always be wealthy, not destitute;

children.text: na ca bhaviṣyati udgṛhītacitto imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_18.12 //
children.translated_text: nor will he be of agitated mind — having retained this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.12 //

children.text: na ca bhaviṣyati vā akṣaṇeṣu mahīpati bheṣyati rājacakravartī /
children.translated_text: "Nor will he be in unfavorable conditions; he will be a sovereign, a <s>Cakravartin</s> king;

children.text: sada bhaviṣyati rājya tasya kṣemaṃ imu varu śānta samādhi dhārayitvā // SRS_18.13 //
children.translated_text: his kingdom will always be secure — having retained this supreme, peaceful <s>samādhi</s>! // SRS_18.13 //

children.text: jñānu vipulu nātra saṃśayo 'sti kṣapayitu kalpaśatehi bhāṣamāṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: "His knowledge is vast — there is no doubt about this — even if one speaks for hundreds of <s>kalpas</s> to exhaust it;

children.text: (Vaidya 129)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 129)

children.text: śruta imu samādhi śāntabhūmī yatha upadiṣṭa tathā sthiheta dhīro // SRS_18.14 //
children.translated_text: having heard this <s>samādhi</s> of the peaceful ground — as it has been taught, so let the steadfast one remain!" // SRS_18.14 //

children.text: aparimita ananta kalpakoṭyo daśabala tasya bhaṇeyurathānuśaṃsām /
children.translated_text: "For immeasurable, infinite <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, the <s>Daśabala</s> could proclaim its benefits;

children.text: na ca parikīrtitā kalā bhaveyyā yatha jalabindu grahītu sāgarāto // SRS_18.15 //
children.translated_text: yet even a fraction could not be fully told — like trying to grasp a drop of water from the ocean!" // SRS_18.15 //

children.text: harṣitu sa kumāru tasmi kāle utthitu prāñjaliko namasyamānaḥ /
children.translated_text: The prince, delighted, rose at that time with joined palms, paying homage;

children.text: daśabalabhimukho sthito udagro giravarāya udānudānayati // SRS_18.16 //
children.translated_text: standing exalted, facing the <s>Daśabala</s>, he uttered this supreme speech: // SRS_18.16 //

children.text: acintiyo mahāvīro lokanātha prabhākaraḥ /
children.translated_text: "Inconceivable is the great hero, the Lord of the World, <s>Prabhākara</s> (Light-Maker)!

children.text: yāvacceme narendreṇa anuśaṃsāḥ prakāśitāḥ // SRS_18.17 //
children.translated_text: How great are the benefits that have been proclaimed by the Lord of Men! // SRS_18.17 //

children.text: ākhyāhi me mahāvīra hitaiṣī anukampakaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Tell me, O great hero, compassionate and benevolent —

children.text: ko nāma paścime kāle idaṃ sūtraṃ śruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.18 //
children.translated_text: who in the latter age will hear this <s>sūtra</s>?" // SRS_18.18 //

children.text: tamenamavadacchāstā kalaviṅkarutasvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: The Teacher answered him, with a voice like that of a <s>kalaviṅka</s> bird;

children.text: asaṅgajñānī bhagavānimāṃ vācaṃ prabhāṣate // SRS_18.19 //
children.translated_text: the Blessed One, possessor of unattached knowledge, spoke these words: // SRS_18.19 //

children.text: kumāra śṛṇu bhāṣiṣye pratipattimanuttarām /
children.translated_text: "Hear, prince, I shall speak of the unsurpassed practice —

children.text: yo dharmānanuśikṣanto idaṃ sūtraṃ śruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.20 //
children.translated_text: who, training in the <s>dharmas</s>, will hear this <s>sūtra</s>: // SRS_18.20 //

children.text: pūjāṃ kurvan jinendrāṇāṃ buddhajñānagaveṣakaḥ /
children.translated_text: "One who worships the supreme <s>Jinas</s>, a seeker of <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge,

children.text: maitracittaṃ niṣevanto idaṃ sūtraṃ śruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.21 //
children.translated_text: cultivating a mind of loving-kindness — he will hear this <s>sūtra</s>! // SRS_18.21 //

children.text: dhūtān guṇāṃśca saṃlekhān guṇān śreṣṭhān niṣevataḥ /
children.translated_text: "One who follows the ascetic purificatory qualities (<s>dhūtaguṇas</s>), the finest virtues,

children.text: pratipattau sthihitvā ca idaṃ sūtraṃ śruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.22 //
children.translated_text: and who is established in practice — he will hear this <s>sūtra</s>! // SRS_18.22 //

children.text: na pāpakāriṇāṃ hastādidaṃ sūtraṃ śruṇiṣyati /
children.translated_text: "This <s>sūtra</s> will not be heard from the hands of evil-doers,

children.text: na yairvirāgitaṃ śīlaṃ lokanāthānamantike // SRS_18.23 //
children.translated_text: nor from those whose morality has degenerated in the presence of the Lords of the World! // SRS_18.23 //

children.text: brahmacārīṇa śūrāṇāṃ yeṣāṃ cittamalolupam /
children.translated_text: "Of celibate heroes, whose minds are not covetous,

children.text: adhiṣṭhitānāṃ buddhehi teṣāṃ hastācchruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.24 //
children.translated_text: who are empowered by the <s>Buddhas</s> — from their hands it will be heard! // SRS_18.24 //

children.text: ye hi purimakā buddhā lokanāthā upasthitāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Those who in the past attended upon former <s>Buddhas</s>, Lords of the World —

children.text: teṣāṃ hastādidaṃ sūtraṃ paścātkāle śruṇiṣyati // SRS_18.25 //
children.translated_text: from their hands this <s>sūtra</s> will be heard in the latter age! // SRS_18.25 //

children.text: ye tu pūrvāsu jātīsu abhūvannanyatīrthikāḥ /
children.translated_text: "But those who in former births were followers of other doctrines —

children.text: teṣvimaṃ śrutva sūtrāntaṃ saumanasyaṃ na bheṣyati // SRS_18.26 //
children.translated_text: upon hearing this <s>sūtrānta</s>, there will be no joy in them! // SRS_18.26 //

children.text: (Vaidya 130)
children.translated_text: (Vaidya p. 130)

children.text: mama ca pravrajitveha śāsane jīvikārthikāḥ /
children.translated_text: "And those who, having gone forth in my teaching here, are seekers of livelihood,

children.text: lābhasatkārābhibhūtā anyamanyaṃ pratikṣipi // SRS_18.27 //
children.translated_text: overpowered by gain and honor — they will reject one another! // SRS_18.27 //

children.text: adhyoṣitā parastrīṣu bahu bhikṣu asaṃyatā /
children.translated_text: "Attached to others' wives, many undisciplined monks,

children.text: lābhakāmāśca duḥśīlā idaṃ sūtraṃ na śraddadhī // SRS_18.28 //
children.translated_text: greedy for gain and immoral — they will not have faith in this <s>sūtra</s>! // SRS_18.28 //

children.text: puṇyānuprāptā buddheṣu dhyānaprāptyāpyanarthikāḥ /
children.translated_text: "Those who have attained merit under the <s>Buddhas</s> but have no interest in attaining <s>dhyāna</s>,

children.text: niśritāścātmasaṃjñāyāmidaṃ sūtraṃ na śraddadhe // SRS_18.29 //
children.translated_text: and who are attached to the perception of self — they will not have faith in this <s>sūtra</s>! // SRS_18.29 //

children.text: laukika dhyānaphalasaṃjñī bheṣyate kāli paścime /
children.translated_text: "Those who perceive the fruit of worldly <s>dhyāna</s> [as ultimate] will exist in the latter age;

children.text: arhatpiṇḍaṃ ca te bhuktvā buddhabodhiṃ pratikṣipi // SRS_18.30 //
children.translated_text: having eaten the alms of <s>Arhats</s>, they will reject the <s>Buddha</s>'s awakening! // SRS_18.30 //

children.text: yaścaiva jambudvīpasmi bhindeyāt sarva cetiyā /
children.translated_text: "If someone were to destroy all the shrines (<s>caityas</s>) in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>,

children.text: yaśca pratikṣipet sūtramidaṃ pāpaṃ viśiṣyate // SRS_18.31 //
children.translated_text: and another were to reject this <s>sūtra</s> — the latter evil is far greater! // SRS_18.31 //

children.text: yaścārhato nihaneyyā yathā gaṅgāya vālukāḥ /
children.translated_text: "If someone were to kill <s>Arhats</s> as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: yaśca pratikṣipet sūtramidaṃ pāpaṃ viśiṣyate // SRS_18.32 //
children.translated_text: and another were to reject this <s>sūtra</s> — the latter evil is far greater! // SRS_18.32 //

children.text: ka utsahanti yuṣmākaṃ paścime kāli dāruṇe /
children.translated_text: "Who among you has the courage, in the dreadful latter age,

children.text: saddharma loke vartante idaṃ sūtraṃ prakāśitum // SRS_18.33 //
children.translated_text: while the true <s>Dharma</s> prevails in the world, to proclaim this <s>sūtra</s>?" // SRS_18.33 //

children.text: rodanto utthitastatra kumāro jinamabravīt /
children.translated_text: Rising there in tears, the prince addressed the <s>Jina</s>;

children.text: siṃhanādaṃ nadatyevaṃ putro buddhasya aurasaḥ // SRS_18.34 //
children.translated_text: the true-born son of the <s>Buddha</s> roared the lion's roar thus: // SRS_18.34 //

children.text: ahaṃ nirvṛte saṃbuddhe paścime kāli dāruṇe /
children.translated_text: "I, when the Perfectly Awakened One has passed into <s>nirvāṇa</s>, in the dreadful latter age —

children.text: sūtraṃ vaistārikaṃ kuryāṃ tyajitvā kāyu jīvitam // SRS_18.35 //
children.translated_text: I shall teach this <s>sūtra</s> extensively, giving up body and life!' // SRS_18.35 //

children.text: sahiṣyāmyatra bālanāmabhūtāṃ paribhāṣaṇām /
children.translated_text: 'I shall endure here the false accusations of fools,

children.text: ākrośāṃstarjanāṃ caiva adhivāsisye nāyaka // SRS_18.36 //
children.translated_text: and their abuse and threats — I shall bear them, O Leader!' // SRS_18.36 //

children.text: kṣapeyaṃ pāpakaṃ karma yanmayā purime kṛtam /
children.translated_text: 'May I exhaust the evil <s>karma</s> formerly done by me;

children.text: anyeṣu bodhisattveṣu vyāpādo janito mayā // SRS_18.37 //
children.translated_text: I generated ill-will toward other <s>Bodhisattvas</s>.' // SRS_18.37 //

children.text: sthapetva pāṇiṃ mūrdhasmi buddhaḥ kāñcanasaṃnibham /
children.translated_text: 'Placing his hand on [Candraprabha's] head — his golden-hued hand —

children.text: śāstā candraprabhaṃ prāha mañjughoṣastathāgataḥ // SRS_18.38 //
children.translated_text: the Teacher addressed <s>Candraprabha</s> — the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Mañjughoṣa</s>:' // SRS_18.38 //

children.text: karomi te adhiṣṭhānaṃ kumāra kāli paścime /
children.translated_text: '"I make this empowerment for you, O prince, in the final age —

children.text: na brahmacaryāntarāyo jīvitasya ca bheṣyati // SRS_18.39 //
children.translated_text: there shall be no obstacle to your celibate conduct or to your life!"' // SRS_18.39 //

children.text: anye cāṣṭau śatānyatra utthitā dharmadhārakāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'And eight hundred others there arose as upholders of the <s>Dharma</s>:

children.text: vayaṃ hi paścime kāle asya sūtrasya dhārakāḥ // SRS_18.40 //
children.translated_text: "We too shall be upholders of this <s>sūtra</s> in the final age!"' // SRS_18.40 //

children.text: (Vaidya 131)
children.translated_text: (<s>Vaidya</s> 131)

children.text: devanāgāna yakṣāṇa aśītikoṭyupasthitā /
children.translated_text: 'Eighty <s>koṭis</s> of gods, <s>Nāgas</s>, and <s>Yakṣas</s> attended;

children.text: anye ca nayutāḥ ṣaṣṭi vandante lokanāyakam // SRS_18.41 //
children.translated_text: and another sixty <s>nayutas</s> bowed to the Lord of the World.' // SRS_18.41 //

children.text: vayamimeṣāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ ya ime adya utthitāḥ /
children.translated_text: '"We, for these monks who have arisen today,

children.text: tasmiṃśca paścime kāle rakṣāṃ kāhāma nāyaka // SRS_18.42 //
children.translated_text: in that final age shall provide protection, O Leader!"' // SRS_18.42 //

children.text: asmin sūtre prabhāṣyante buddhakṣetrāḥ prakampitāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'In this <s>sūtra</s> it is proclaimed that <s>Buddha</s>-fields are caused to tremble —

children.text: yathā vāluka gaṅgāyā adhiṣṭhānena śāstunaḥ // SRS_18.43 //
children.translated_text: as many as the sands of the Ganges — by the empowerment of the Teacher.' // SRS_18.43 //

children.text: ye ca prakampitāḥ kṣetrāḥ sarveṣu buddhanirmitāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'And in those fields that were caused to tremble, in all of them <s>Buddha</s>-emanations

children.text: preṣitā lokanāthena ye hi dharmāḥ prakāśitāḥ // SRS_18.44 //
children.translated_text: were sent by the Lord of the World — and the <s>dharmas</s> were illuminated.' // SRS_18.44 //

children.text: ekaikaśaśca kṣetrātaḥ sattvakoṭyo acintiyāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'From each field, inconceivable <s>koṭis</s> of beings,

children.text: evaṃ dharmaṃ tadā śrutvā buddhajñāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ // SRS_18.45 //
children.translated_text: having thus heard the <s>Dharma</s>, were established in <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge.' // SRS_18.45 //

children.text: itaśca buddhakṣetrāto navatirdevakoṭiyaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'And from this <s>Buddha</s>-field, ninety <s>koṭis</s> of gods,

children.text: bodhicittaṃ samutpādya buddhaṃ puṣpairavākiran // SRS_18.46 //
children.translated_text: having generated <s>bodhicitta</s>, showered the <s>Buddha</s> with flowers.' // SRS_18.46 //

children.text: te vyākṛtā narendreṇa kalpakoṭeraśītibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: 'They were predicted by the Lord of Men — in eighty <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>;

children.text: sarve 'pyekatra kalpe 'smin bhaviṣyanti vināyakāḥ // SRS_18.47 //
children.translated_text: all, in this very <s>kalpa</s>, shall become Guides.' // SRS_18.47 //

children.text: bhikṣubhikṣuṇikāścaiva upāsaka upāsikāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Monks and nuns, male and female lay followers —

children.text: ṣaṭsaptati prāṇakoṭyo yehi sūtramidaṃ śrutam // SRS_18.48 //
